2610.18950.t: λ_0: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
2610.18950.s: HumanVerse pairs egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion to train a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation via human-to-robot transfer without target-task robot demonstrations.

2610.19419.t: WinARDet: Compressed Window Auto-Regression for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Grounding
2610.19419.s: Compressed Window Auto-Regression partitions long answer sequences into windows with restricted autoregression and compressed latent history to prevent attention takeover and box repetition in dense vision-language grounding.

2603.19233.t: Not All Features Are Created Equal: A Mechanistic Study of Vision-Language-Action Models
2603.19233.s: A mechanistic interpretability study of vision-language-action policies reveals that motor programs are bound to absolute coordinates and ignores visual scene changes, with sparse autoencoder analysis separating instruction encoding and motor generation across architectures.

2610.09513.t: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
2610.09513.s: OmniCam is an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from panoramas and text, using geometric and target-aware conditioning to improve trajectory accuracy and reduce collisions.

2610.26825.s: MemT-1.0 introduces a memory-native architecture that embeds continuous memory into foundation model computation, improving long-context efficiency and agentic task performance.

2610.26860.t: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
2610.26860.s: OpenVLHarness improves multimodal reasoning by integrating persistent memory, heterogeneous tool interfaces, and iterative evidence composition across 22 benchmarks.

2610.22791.t: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
2610.22791.s: Self-HPO is a recursive framework that alternates harness and policy optimization for coding agents, improving performance by targeting evolving failure modes through reinforcement learning.

2610.24960.t: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
2610.24960.s: CoworkEnv synthesizes executable training environments for AI coworkers using workflow-guided task construction and programmatic validation, enabling supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning of compact PocketWorker models that improve multi-turn coordination and tool use.

2610.26625.t: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
2610.26625.s: EgoXperience introduces a unified framework for joint reconstruction of camera motion, scene geometry, hands, and objects from egocentric video using automatically annotated large-scale data and a single-pass model.

2610.26549.t: Holi-World: Building Holistic World Intelligence from Human-Ego Experience
2610.26549.s: HOLI-WORLD is an integrated ecosystem that automates the construction of large-scale learning resources from egocentric recordings to improve machine understanding of dynamic scenes and interactions.

2610.26844.t: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
2610.26844.s: Researchers introduce AnyGoal to evaluate whether world models can generalize dynamics to unseen combinations of familiar states and actions for planning.

2610.25404.t: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
2610.25404.s: MT Forcing improves multi-turn image editing by combining single-turn distribution matching distillation and teacher-forcing guidance to stabilize visual quality and preserve cross-turn consistency.

2610.25690.t: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
2610.25690.s: ScaleNav learns goal-directed visual dynamics from internet egocentric videos to generate robot actions for language-conditioned local navigation, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-world deployment.

2610.26834.t: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
2610.26834.s: KronLSTM introduces a Kronecker Delta Rule for stable associative memory updates in linear attention, improving long-context modeling without extra normalization.

2610.26802.t: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
2610.26802.s: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with low-rank adapters enables efficient adaptation of very large multimodal backbones for brain encoding, improving performance and interpretability while reducing computational cost.

2610.26770.t: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
2610.26770.s: HarnessPro evolves AI agent harnesses without labels to boost task success and lower execution costs, yielding lightweight, balanced, and high-performance variants via trajectory diagnosis and weighted selection.

2610.17724.s: Sauron is an evidence-first agentic verifier that independently validates claims against environment state and execution traces to improve rubric-based evaluation accuracy and reduce reinforcement-learning reward errors.

2610.25011.t: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
2610.25011.s: FineSplat improves feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting by using fine-grained patches, dual grouping for efficient multi-view interaction, rendering-based feedback, and compact Gaussian generation to recover richer geometry and appearance efficiently.

2609.22332.t: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
2609.22332.s: AffordanceWAM uses affordance representations from human videos to jointly predict future scenes and robot actions, improving manipulation transfer without human action labels.

2606.31876.t: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
2606.31876.s: MARS enables multimodal safety steering using only text-derived refusal directions, avoiding the need for multimodal safety data.

2610.25666.t: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
2610.25666.s: Fréchet Forcing fine-tunes streaming video world models using self-generated rollouts and real-data statistics to prevent long-horizon drift without requiring teachers or long videos.

2610.22328.t: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
2610.22328.s: Self-forcing training with teacher distillation and asymmetric conditioning stabilizes multi-turn image editing against accumulating distribution shifts.

2610.17816.t: Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution
2610.17816.s: EC2-Bench evaluates edge-cloud collaboration for long-horizon LLM agents, revealing trade-offs among performance, resource use, and privacy, and showing that stronger edge models favor more edge-controlled collaboration.

2610.22512.t: Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On-Policy Self-Distillation
2610.22512.s: On-policy self-distillation with privileged information improves multi-turn agent performance depending on content and source, and KL-based metrics better predict training gains than direct utility estimates.

2610.20597.t: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
2610.20597.s: CoPE improves agentic reinforcement learning by training policies to generate multi-step action sequences from trajectory histories, increasing sample efficiency without inference overhead.

2610.21791.t: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
2610.21791.s: RSIFlow is a recursive self-improvement framework that dynamically selects component-specific workflows based on execution feedback and evolves a meta-agent to refine orchestration and skills.

2610.25296.t: World Model Interpretability: From Decoding Representations to Understanding Latent Worlds
2610.25296.s: JEPA latent-world interpretability should shift from decoding representations to analyzing how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction through grounding, structuring, verifying, and acting.

2610.22466.t: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
2610.22466.s: Harness-Delta Attribution dissects harness evolution gains into overfitting, test-time scaling, and residual generalizable improvement, finding that most search-set gains do not reliably transfer to held-out tasks.

2610.23653.t: A Language-Informed Loss for Visual Generation
2610.23653.s: LILIE uses an invertible normalizing-flow encoder to derive language-informed supervision for text-to-image generation, improving fidelity over pixel-only training.

2610.24133.t: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
2610.24133.s: Autoregressive transformers retain prompt influence via a power-law decay driven by attention dilution and relay mechanisms, with trained models forgetting faster than untrained ones.

2610.22471.s: GPT-6-Astra achieves high performance across diverse robotic tasks via in-context learning, yet real-world deployment reveals gaps in demonstration cost, execution time, and practical embodied intelligence.

2610.23374.s: MOSS-Image is an open diffusion transformer that combines high-fidelity synthesis with intent-aware prompt enhancement to generate text-rich, layout-coherent images, achieving state-of-the-art open-weight results on long-form text and layout benchmarks.

2610.20951.t: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models
2610.20951.s: LEV is a looped decision model that increases reasoning depth by iterating its layers without generating tokens, improving accuracy on hard questions while allowing adaptive computation via a stopper.

2610.23479.t: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
2610.23479.s: HexaShell is a coding agent that controls a dual-arm robot via vision and self-written tools, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo but struggling with contact-heavy tasks.

2610.19159.t: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
2610.19159.s: Researchers benchmarked AI agents on open scientific problems by having them draft follow-up papers from unpublished directions, finding that none met expert standards and most contained fabricated claims or contradictory evidence.

2610.20424.t: BizBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
2610.20424.s: BizBench evaluates long-horizon business agents on intermediate execution validity using real-world payment procedures, revealing that frontier models frequently violate constraints despite achieving partial goal success.

2610.23279.s: Xiaomi-Lens-0 is a 4B multimodal model that predicts masks from internal visual representations to improve fine-grained region reasoning and referring comprehension.

2610.14746.t: BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
2610.14746.s: BridgeWAM decouples video and action experts via latent bridge queries to improve action prediction efficiency and generalization in world action models.

2610.23181.t: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2610.23181.s: TreeOPSD enables long-horizon reinforcement learning for language model agents without critics by using tree-structured self-distillation with bounded updates derived from terminal rewards.

2610.09872.t: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
2610.09872.s: LiveMACEBench evaluates persistent LLM agents in live financial markets using decision traces to reveal gaps between outcomes and underlying capabilities.

2610.21459.t: Can Visual Generation Expand What Unified Multimodal Models Know?
2610.21459.s: Visual image-generation training can expand pretrained multimodal models' knowledge, with alignment techniques improving text-based access to that visually acquired information.

2610.23542.t: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
2610.23542.s: MIST separates scene setup from change execution to isolate memory failures in video world models, and M3-Agent improves instruction execution to significantly boost benchmark scores.

2610.23787.t: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
2610.23787.s: DLite improves speculative decoding for agentic AI by eliminating historical context maintenance and using target hidden states for local predictions, boosting acceptance length and reducing overhead.

2610.22448.t: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
2610.22448.s: Lean4AgenticRL integrates multi-level process rewards into a Lean4 formalization framework to improve agentic reinforcement learning for software engineering and terminal tasks, yielding stronger model performance.

2610.09221.t: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
2610.09221.s: Consistent Distribution Matching accelerates diffusion and flow models via simulation-free, data-free distillation that unifies generation and score estimation, achieving strong one-step and few-step results.

2610.20628.t: PRISM: PRIvileged Sibling-guided Multi-Agent Topology Design
2610.20628.s: PRISM improves multi-agent topology generators by recovering per-query preferences via privileged sibling-graph information, reducing cross-task drift.

2610.18082.t: Failure Recovery via Belief Updates and World Modeling for Long-Horizon Agents
2610.18082.s: BELIEFWEAVER improves long-horizon agent recovery by combining persistent evidence with prospective reasoning and distilling reasoning into a smaller model.

2610.19636.t: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
2610.19636.s: SAE-IDF matches symbolic units across heterogeneous systems using sparse autoencoders and rarity-weighted features, enabling scalable neuro-symbolic reasoning.

2610.22708.t: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
2610.22708.s: GlobeBench introduces a standardized benchmark of 1,632 tasks across five domains to evaluate text-based world models, revealing that current LLMs struggle with propagating action effects across dependent objects.

2610.23795.t: Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models
2610.23795.s: PPMem is a video world model that uses compact plane primitives as persistent 3D memory to generate long coherent videos with explicit metric geometry.

2610.20503.t: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
2610.20503.s: ReaDy accelerates autoregressive generation by using hybrid linear attention recurrent states to retrieve position-specific context for speculative drafting, improving speed and acceptance rates.

2610.19378.t: Robust Explanatory Analysis for Structured Optimization Networks (REASON) in Learning
2610.19378.s: A two-loop inference framework resolves residual errors via fast and evidence-seeking loops to improve robustness under distribution shift with lower computation.

2610.22697.t: What It Is, Not What It Says: Securing Agentic Browsing Interactions with Web Semantics
2610.22697.s: Intact protects AI web agents by isolating webpage elements via provenance-aware representations and enforcing capability-bound execution with user consent for third-party actions.

2610.22347.t: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
2610.22347.s: Speculative Forcing accelerates few-step autoregressive video generation by accepting early token drafts and skipping unnecessary denoising steps while preserving output quality.

2610.22276.t: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
2610.22276.s: MJev-Spatial is a fast multimodal decision model that unifies spatial reasoning tasks into a single-pass classification framework, improving speed and accuracy over autoregressive vision-language models.

2610.22174.s: Multi-session agentic reinforcement learning is introduced to handle trajectories across multiple sessions, with Mosaic optimizing session-level contributions and allocation via hierarchical advantage estimation.

2610.22341.s: 3DCodeVerse is a research ecosystem that provides datasets, automated verification harnesses, and empirical guidance to enable scalable, editable, and verifiable 3D content generation via executable code.

2610.18829.t: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
2610.18829.s: OmniCompass is a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding that evaluates vision-language and audio-visual reasoning through temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and question answering tasks.

2610.20818.t: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
2610.20818.s: Intern Lumina U2 is a diffusion language model that uses multi-codebook discrete visual tokens to unify image, video, and 3D generation with text in a single backbone, achieving high performance and faster inference.

2610.20939.t: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
2610.20939.s: MAI-Gym is an open platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online reinforcement learning training across mobile, computer, and web environments, enabling scalable synthesis of verified tasks and training of a unified 9B agent with state-of-the-art open performance.

2610.22194.t: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
2610.22194.s: AutoSFT uses multi-agent collaboration to automate diverse supervised fine-tuning data actions, improving evaluation scores over single-agent systems by separating execution, analysis, and synthesis.

2610.19849.t: DeltaStreamer: Towards Human-Like Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
2610.19849.s: DeltaStreamer is an agentic framework for streaming video understanding that uses change-aware memory and query-driven replay to preserve event dynamics and recover missing visual evidence for accurate answers.

2610.21601.t: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
2610.21601.s: Waypoint-OPD improves policy-shift distillation by gating endpoint shifts using directional agreement between early and late teacher policy changes, boosting reasoning performance with minimal overhead.

2610.12625.t: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
2610.12625.s: A framework dynamically assigns denoising steps to video patches based on difficulty, cutting computation by half while preserving quality.

2610.22355.t: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
2610.22355.s: A graded visual verifier decomposes complex multimodal rules into pointwise scores and uses decoupled reinforcement learning to improve generalization, with pairwise verification further enhancing structured world-modeling accuracy.

2610.21439.t: Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL
2610.21439.o: Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
2610.21439.s: MRTPO improves multi-reward training by assigning each reward's advantage only to relevant tokens via replay-based relevance measurement, accelerating convergence and boosting performance.

2610.22264.t: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
2610.22264.s: SCOPE improves text-to-image prompt rewriting via reinforcement learning by aligning policy updates with semantic spans, boosting generation quality without extra rendering.

2610.17560.t: EdgeWise: Bringing Long-Horizon Agents to the Edge via Selective Cloud Delegation
2610.17560.s: EdgeWise uses a local small language model with selective cloud delegation via reinforcement learning to reduce inference costs on long-horizon agent tasks without sacrificing performance.

2610.22282.t: Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
2610.22282.s: Routing Policy Optimization introduces stochastic attention routing inside diffusion generators to align them with reward signals while preserving the original deterministic sampler and improving training efficiency.

2610.21412.t: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
2610.21412.s: A harness that delegates agent tool choices to small decision models via fitted confidence thresholds reduces cost and latency while preserving task success, supported by a new benchmark and a 4B model trained on agent error states.

2610.21463.t: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
2610.21463.s: SpecAgent improves agent efficiency by having a small model draft tool-use steps that a large model verifies in parallel, reducing latency and memory use while preserving quality.

2610.22311.t: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
2610.22311.s: Velox accelerates long video rollouts by routing attention via geometric frustum slabs, reducing latency while preserving visual coherence.

2610.13781.t: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
2610.13781.s: SimVTA improves driving world action models by combining simulator-rendered video supervision with reinforcement learning trajectory optimization.

2610.21095.t: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
2610.21095.s: OneWM unifies causal training of world and action modeling, showing that learning action-conditioned dynamics improves policies and action learning improves multi-view world prediction.

2610.21261.t: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
2610.21261.s: Sparse autoencoder features are partially compositional but require interaction terms for accurate behavioral predictions and steering.

2610.17113.t: Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction
2610.17113.s: CalOn is a compact unified encoder that jointly performs entity, relation, and event extraction across diverse schemas by encoding text with type definitions and using shared probabilistic reasoning over combined type evidence.

2610.19247.s: Copy-Paste Language Models enhance in-context copying by adding a lightweight head that improves training efficiency, downstream performance, and long-context retrieval with minimal overhead.

2610.19397.t: SERO: Learning from Executable Oracle Continuations for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2610.19397.s: SERO improves long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning by training on executable oracle continuations from real policy states, weighted by policy compatibility, without inference-time overhead.

2610.19605.t: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
2610.19605.s: PN-Mix improves low-bit KV cache quantization by identifying salient RoPE channel pairs via query-key norms, achieving strong accuracy at lower bit rates.

2610.21025.t: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
2610.21025.s: Hidden states encode task information before the readout expresses it, so behavioral timelines reflect readout learning rather than model acquisition, and faster readout training closes this gap earlier.

2610.20111.t: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
2610.20111.s: Representation Forcing improves few-step video generation by using feature-space supervision instead of trajectory regression, boosting quality metrics over causal ODE baselines.

2610.18125.t: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
2610.18125.s: H-DDCM replaces dense Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries and table-free lexicographic coding to enable scalable, efficient generative image and video compression using diffusion and flow models.

2610.06598.t: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
2610.06598.s: SimForcing improves action-conditioned robot world models by distilling motion knowledge from simulation and using controllable simulation conditioning to generate realistic videos across robot datasets.

2610.20399.t: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
2610.20399.s: Cortex consolidates context-induced improvements into mergeable low-rank or structural updates, preserving non-target capabilities across sequential edits and diverse model scales.

2610.13521.t: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
2610.13521.s: Road MOPD reduces gradient conflicts in multi-teacher distillation by using cross-teacher agreement for token-level credit assignment and auxiliary gradients to constrain conflicting updates.

2610.20584.t: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
2610.20584.s: Player-1 improves game control by combining supervised fine-tuning on gameplay trajectories with reinforcement learning across synthetic environments, achieving substantial gains over demonstration-only baselines.

2610.19820.s: ActionOPD aligns smaller language-model agents with teachers via semantic action-level on-policy distillation, improving out-of-distribution tool-use performance without requiring shared tokenizers or teacher probabilities.

2610.19366.t: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
2610.19366.s: This work proposes a two-axis framework for multimodal agent memory covering information formation and adaptive management to support lifelong learning.

2610.19975.t: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
2610.19975.s: LatentLoop improves looped Mixture-of-Experts by compressing the first loop visit, reallocating saved computation to larger hidden dimensions, and using separate attention parameters, yielding lower validation loss and better benchmark scores.

2610.20344.t: Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents
2610.20344.s: Doc2Harness is a deterministic two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering by having models build and run harnesses across isolated containers, revealing substantial performance gaps among frontier models.

2610.19789.t: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2610.19789.s: Researchers benchmarked ten self-distillation methods against GRPO across multiple agent tasks and model sizes, finding limited consistent gains, hidden training instability, and no reliable cost-to-performance benefit.

2610.14162.t: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
2610.14162.s: Next-Concept Modeling uses hierarchical discrete codes and parallel level-wise generation to accelerate diffusion language models while improving quality and reasoning performance.

2610.14448.t: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
2610.14448.s: KV4-RL accelerates reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards via INT4 KV cache quantization with selective INT8 protection, achieving substantial speedups with minimal accuracy loss.

2610.19128.t: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
2610.19128.s: CLASHarness introduces a controllable framework for generating verifiable multi-agent conflicts in computer-use tasks, revealing that frontier vision-language models struggle with verifying ground truth, resolving conflicts, and coordinating shared resources.

2610.18861.s: Hybrid Reasoning Agents combine latent internal reasoning with text-based external interaction via a unified architecture and specialized post-training, improving agent performance while reducing inference cost and token usage.

2610.17309.t: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
2610.17309.s: StartLux-Decision introduces efficient and adaptive decision models using single-pass prediction and confidence-guided reasoning, trained via a three-stage pipeline with RLCD² reinforcement learning, and evaluates them on Decision Index and the DecisionPivot benchmark.

2610.14270.t: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
2610.14270.o: KAUST Center of Excellence in Generative AI
2610.14270.s: Reinforcement learning gains in hybrid reasoning models' NO-THINK mode largely stem from reactivating existing THINK-mode reasoning rather than learning new capabilities.

2610.20572.t: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
2610.20572.s: CriticOPD improves on-policy distillation by using teacher critiques to restore recoverability, enabling students to revise incorrect reasoning and achieve stronger mathematical reasoning performance.

2610.13623.t: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
2610.13623.o: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
2610.13623.s: APEX-Harm evaluates long-horizon agent vulnerabilities to injection attacks across large multi-tool workspaces, revealing high success rates for script-based attacks despite correct task outputs.

2610.04781.t: Super-Resolution in The Right Latent Space: A Frozen Vision-Foundation Substrate
2610.04781.s: Real-world super-resolution is improved by mapping degraded image embeddings back to a high-resolution manifold within a frozen DINOv3-L latent space, yielding high fidelity and fast inference.

2610.19118.t: DecisionRobust: Benchmarking Robustness for JEV Style Decision Models Across Text and Vision
2610.19118.s: DecisionRobust evaluates decision model reliability against adversarial text, image, and prompt injection attacks, showing that robustness varies by task and that label consistency checks reduce apparent attack success.

2610.17191.t: FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation
2610.17191.s: FreeSolo introduces a native sparse attention mechanism with short-range and long-range branches that achieves linear-time complexity and improves zero-shot length extrapolation without costly long-context fine-tuning.

2610.15715.t: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
2610.15715.o: KAUST Center of Excellence in Generative AI
2610.15715.s: NoteBank augments linear attention models with a sparse episodic memory that stores selected text and replays it through native computation, greatly improving long-context retrieval without extra training or significant overhead.

2610.19560.t: τ-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
2610.19560.s: A benchmark and data pipeline evaluate and improve LLM tool-calling agents under emotionally varied user interactions by filtering ineffective trajectories and scaling supervised training.

2610.19026.t: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
2610.19026.s: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention improves long-context decoding by learning a shared low-dimensional query-key subspace for accurate token selection and using a gather-free kernel, achieving near-full accuracy with substantially higher throughput.

2610.14774.t: ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training
2610.14774.s: ProgAgent introduces a programmatic tool-calling training framework that improves long-horizon agent performance by using executable code and runtime variables instead of sequential context accumulation.

2610.19628.t: Self-Conditioning Enables Deep Sequential Reasoning in Flow Matching
2610.19628.s: Flow matching with self-conditioning enables deeper visual reasoning by allowing iterative sampling steps to increase expressive power beyond constant-depth limits.

2610.18755.t: PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards
2610.18755.s: PreciseCoder improves code repair by rewarding precise, localized edits rather than only unit-test passage, reducing unnecessary changes and improving generalization across model sizes.

2610.17246.t: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators
2610.17246.s: LLM-to-Flow Distillation aligns scientific generators with high-level discovery goals by using a frozen LLM to build adaptive curricula and distill preferences via DPO, enabling control over peptide and small-molecule design.

2610.17016.t: ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty
2610.17016.s: ProbabilityBench supplies exact instance-level class probabilities across simulated text domains to directly evaluate model calibration and benchmark standard metrics against known ground truth.

2610.20604.t: VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action
2610.20604.s: VITAL derives driving actions from visual motion via a coupled motion scaffold and residual tokenizer, enabling fast, accurate trajectory prediction and bounded reinforcement refinement.

2610.19121.t: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
2610.19121.s: LayerTrim is a training-free structured pruning approach that removes redundant decoder layers and trims MLP features to preserve reasoning ability, reducing inference costs and generation length.

2610.20516.t: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
2610.20516.o: University of Science and Technology of China
2610.20516.s: Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization integrates a self-teacher and critic within PPO to improve reasoning by combining token-level advantages with bounded probability ratios, boosting accuracy on mathematical benchmarks.

2610.20220.t: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
2610.20220.s: Glance Forcing improves video generation efficiency by splitting denoising into specialized experts guided by stage-specific objectives, reducing training costs while improving quality.

2610.20582.s: Latent Compaction uses test-time training to learn compact, document-specific key-value caches that preserve retrieval accuracy under aggressive compression without requiring downstream questions.

2610.10787.t: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
2610.10787.s: NavGPT-3 integrates long-horizon reasoning with low-latency action policies via an OS-like runtime, achieving human-level embodied navigation performance.

2610.17301.t: The Agent Knew: Internal States Forecast Unauthorized Actions and Stop Them, and the Lies That Follow
2610.17301.s: Residual-stream forecasting detects unauthorized agent actions and false reports before they occur, enabling low-cost gating that reduces violations and prompt-injection attacks without harming task completion.

2610.20588.s: The method converts pre-trained transformers into elastic models that adapt continuously to varying computational budgets by jointly ranking and softly pruning individual neurons and attention heads across multiple sparsity targets without retraining.

2610.17079.t: Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?
2610.17079.s: Shallow late fusion of LLM-generated reasoning guidance outperforms deep attention injection in knowledge-based VQA under limited data, highlighting that integration depth should align with the training regime.

2610.18638.t: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
2610.18638.s: COMPASS estimates model-pair compatibility before alignment or merging by measuring local neighborhood overlap and paradigm limits, guiding resource allocation across cross-modal and merging tasks.

2610.13239.t: Jag: Direct Box Prediction for Efficient Visual Grounding
2610.13239.s: Jag adapts a compact pretrained multimodal model to predict bounding boxes directly via a regression head, improving grounding accuracy and reducing inference latency.

2610.20524.t: Physical Time as a Missing Dimension of Robot Policy Memory Dynamics
2610.20524.s: Temporal Flow Policy integrates measured time intervals into robot memory dynamics to improve action timing and retention of past events across physical time.

2606.24472.t: G^3VLA: Geometric Inductive Bias for Vision-Language-Action Models
2606.24472.s: G³VLA injects calibrated multi-camera geometry into vision-language-action models via ray embeddings and cross-view fusion, improving robot manipulation without changing the action space.

2610.20137.t: StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing
2610.20137.s: StreamErase enables real-time, streaming video object removal with sub-second latency by transferring erasing capabilities from a bidirectional model to an efficient unidirectional streaming generator using sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks.

2610.18773.t: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
2610.18773.s: Jeva is a decision-native architecture that jointly enforces null-awareness, permutation invariance, option scalability, and cross-request caching for structured decision-making.

2610.18356.t: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
2610.18356.s: Urbex reframes city-scale 3D grounding as an active search process using a vision-language agent with reinforcement learning, improving accuracy and speed without precomputed proposals.

2610.18774.t: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics
2610.18774.s: GreenWAM is a unified world foundation model for robotics that uses a shared anatomical action space and joint training to serve as both a predictive world model and a control policy across diverse robot bodies.

2610.18615.t: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
2610.18615.s: VideoJev converts video observations into structured decisions by scoring temporal intervals and text options, enabling efficient reusable inference for visual agents.

2610.14709.t: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
2610.14709.s: Vela converts real-world user behavior records into training tasks and trajectories, improving large language model performance on user-related and general benchmarks through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

2610.14224.t: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
2610.14224.s: Harness² improves agent execution harnesses through recursive task-level refinement and continual harness-level learning, boosting performance across benchmarks without ground-truth verifiers.

2610.13990.s: DoSA accelerates sparse attention by using a certificate to conditionally score only eligible tokens, preserving exact selection while reducing computation.

2610.15028.t: UltraBERT: Beyond the Limit of BERT Pre-Training
2610.15028.s: UltraBERT improves bidirectional encoder performance by optimizing masking ratios, compute allocation, and distillation to achieve state-of-the-art results on both classification and retrieval benchmarks.

2610.01496.t: SALD: Self-Referenced Advantage Learning for Diffusion Models
2610.01496.s: SALD is a self-referenced training framework for diffusion models that uses dual noise-level evaluation and adaptive weighting to improve generation quality without external teachers or extra parameters.

2610.18868.t: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
2610.18868.s: Tev-Gym provides verified long-horizon training environments with dense progressive rewards, and progress-potential reward shaping enables efficient training of Tev-27B, which achieves competitive long-horizon agent performance.

2610.12843.t: APEX: Asynchronous Prefix Denoising for Extreme Compression
2610.12843.s: APEX uses hierarchical latent spaces and asynchronous denoising over channel groups to achieve extreme image compression with high generation quality at low compute.

2610.17227.t: AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers
2610.17227.s: AReA improves high-resolution image generation with diffusion transformers by adapting attention from global to local across denoising steps without extra training.

2610.17953.t: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
2610.17953.s: Agent-Reflex trains interactive agents to reflect and recover from noisy tool feedback and user corrections through skill discovery, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy optimization.

2610.17928.t: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents
2610.17928.s: SwitchMem dynamically selects between textual and visual memory representations at each interaction step for vision-language GUI agents, improving performance over fixed-modality approaches.

2610.18067.t: WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution
2610.18067.s: WorkRover enables iterative refinement of interactive training environments for long-horizon agents via recursive synthesis, compatibility replay, and turn-level credit assignment.

2610.17666.t: DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter
2610.17666.s: DeltaTTG learns a reusable progress signal via token-to-go estimates to redistribute advantages across steps in multi-turn reinforcement learning, improving scores and efficiency without extra task rules.

2610.16354.s: Self-distillation with verbal regularization improves reasoning by using system prompts to reduce shortcut bias from privileged information, preserving output diversity and boosting accuracy.

2610.18472.t: Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion
2610.18472.s: Simplified Matching Distillation enables efficient few-step generation across images, video, 3D, and audio using pure velocity regression with a residual proxy and weak-teacher repulsion, scaling to 33 billion parameters.

2610.18872.t: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
2610.18872.s: EgoExplorer is a wearable vision-motion-touch dataset of human loco-manipulation that uses a calibration and completion pipeline to reconstruct whole-body motion, finger articulation, and tactile data from sparse sensors.

2610.18568.t: WAVE-0: Bridging VLA Policies and WAMs with Lightweight Latent Future Prediction
2610.18568.s: WAVE-0 integrates a lightweight latent world model with pretrained vision-language-action policies to guide robotic manipulation via predicted future consequences, achieving high success rates without video pretraining or pixel reconstruction.

2610.15915.t: VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
2610.15915.s: ViewCraft jointly improves an evidence interface and reading procedure to boost multimodal agent performance across benchmarks without weight updates.

2610.14091.s: Pristine Models compartmentalize safe and unsafe knowledge into separate branches during pretraining, allowing unsafe parameters to be detached at inference to improve safety without sacrificing image quality.

2610.17656.t: Open-o3-Video-v2: Seek, Ground, and Reason with Verifiable Spatio-Temporal Evidence
2610.17656.s: Open-o3-Video-v2 treats video reasoning as an agentic process that actively retrieves visual evidence, grounds objects and timestamps, and writes verifiable traces into its reasoning trajectory, achieving substantial gains on reasoning and grounding benchmarks.

2610.18010.s: Fish Audio Drama 3 is an open-source 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts speech generation model that produces directed, multi-character performances with voice cloning, multi-turn revision, infilling, and streaming, using a hybrid linear-attention backbone and a multi-token-prediction decoder trained via three-stage pre-training, instruction fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning from human preference.

2610.12818.t: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs
2610.12818.s: LeWAM is an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture that jointly learns latent dynamics and action flow matching for efficient planning and direct control.

2610.14293.t: GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation
2610.14293.s: GeoFix improves geometric consistency and visual quality in 4D video generation by using a calibrated cross-view depth consistency reward that avoids degrading textures or penalizing motion.

2610.16118.t: Elephant in the Fridge: Constant-Memory Frame Packing for Long Video Understanding
2610.16118.o: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
2610.16118.s: FramePack-U is a training-free method that compresses long videos into fixed-size visual representations for vision-language models by selecting diverse, prompt-relevant frames and packing them at varying resolutions, improving accuracy and reducing memory costs.

2610.18092.t: LifeSearch: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents for Real-World Life and Productivity
2610.18092.s: LifeSearch is a benchmark of 203 real-world life and productivity tasks that reveals deep research agents still fall short of human-level performance.

2610.18579.t: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
2610.18579.s: Fast agent models frequently choose wrong actions despite correctly reading the state, with errors clustering on specific states and persisting even when all relevant facts are known, indicating failures in reasoning and sub-goal formation rather than perception.

2610.14228.t: Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents
2610.14228.s: Shifting GUI world modeling from pixel reconstruction to latent action-conditioned predictions improves efficiency and avoids identity shortcuts via contrastive learning.

2610.18846.t: WorldRecon: Generative Multi-View Mesh Reconstruction for Large-Scale 3D World
2610.18846.s: WorldRecon is a generative framework that reconstructs complete large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed images by using imperfect global point clouds as scaffolds, block-wise generation with reconstruction conditioning, and neighbor-aware inpainting for coherence.

2610.18766.t: Rubrics from the Task, Verdicts from Evidence: Pointwise Rubric Rewards with Tool-Augmented Judges
2610.18766.s: ReVeR is a pointwise rubric reward model that derives criteria directly from instructions and uses tool-augmented judging to evaluate responses independently, improving preference accuracy and policy optimization.

2610.15772.t: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
2610.15772.o: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
2610.15772.s: RSIPO is a self-evolving agentic reinforcement learning framework that co-evolves agentic skills and policies while calibrating teacher supervision reliability via empirical Bayes shrinkage.

2610.18760.t: Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback
2610.18760.s: ARBITER is a reinforcement-learning-trained mixture-of-experts verifier that diagnoses programming errors with generated counterexamples, improving test-time selection and refinement of code solutions.

2610.18614.t: Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents
2610.18614.s: Calibrating an LLM agent's step-level confidence against final episode outcomes improves failure prediction and selective execution across multi-step environments.

2610.18862.t: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
2610.18862.s: DoubtLess uses a small reasoning model to steer larger models toward shorter chain-of-thought outputs without training, reducing token usage while preserving accuracy.

2610.18497.t: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments
2610.18497.s: Judges evaluating LLM agent arguments exhibit a derivation gap when correct values lack visible references, which is mitigated by a separate DeRef model that writes explicit references to improve evaluation accuracy.

2610.00359.t: Diffusion Editing with Soft Mask: Pixel Level Redo of Image and Video with Adjustable Strength
2610.00359.s: SoftPaint enables continuous, pixel-level image and video editing via soft masks using a gradient-free Langevin-based sampler without requiring annotations.

2610.18738.t: Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization
2610.18738.s: Proximal KL improves off-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by using token-wise importance weighting and bounded future KL credit, achieving higher accuracy and stability than existing methods.

2610.16172.t: EventLens: Event-Structure Reinforcement Learning for Video Understanding
2610.16172.s: EventLens improves video temporal reasoning by training multimodal models to recover event structure via reinforcement learning with deterministic rewards and multi-teacher distillation.

2610.17540.t: TacitVLA: Reasoning Vision-Language-Action Models Without Reasoning Latency
2610.17540.s: TacitVLA improves vision-language-action models by decoupling reasoning supervision from action generation, reducing latency while maintaining or improving task success across manipulation and driving benchmarks.

2610.02638.t: Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen LLM Hear Beyond the Transcript
2610.02638.s: DuplexJev enables rapid full-duplex voice decision-making by feeding ASR encoder states into a frozen LLM via connectors, achieving high accuracy for spoken QA and speaker attributes without autoregressive decoding.

2610.13166.t: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
2610.13166.s: TerminalHorizon automates long-horizon terminal agent data synthesis by reconstructing environments around omitted work and progressively expanding tasks, yielding substantial gains across coding, production, and reasoning benchmarks.

2609.39601.t: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
2609.39601.s: GroundingPI is a 4B grounding foundation model that improves precise object localization and downstream robotic and autonomous driving performance through multimodal pretraining and reinforcement learning.

2610.13361.t: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
2610.13361.s: AgentSWE evaluates whether coding agents build software that truly meets user requirements across creation, editing, and optimization stages, revealing widespread failures to deliver faithful behavior.

2610.13630.s: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals extend depth-wise attention to multi-head retrieval with adaptive mixing, improving efficiency and performance in large-scale pre-training.

2609.36642.t: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2609.36642.s: PR-OPD improves language-model agent training by aligning hidden states to a self-distilled skill teacher, boosting success rates without extra inference cost.

2609.39600.t: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
2609.39600.s: GroundAnything is a 4B-parameter visual grounding model that uses bidirectional diffusion and blockwise denoising to enable fast parallel decoding with precise localization, outperforming autoregressive counterparts across 30 benchmarks.

2609.36616.t: CrossTimeEdit: A Decade-Spanning Cross-View Dataset and Reward-Guided Editing for Historical Street-View Generation
2609.36616.s: CrossTimeEdit edits recent street views using satellite change evidence to generate historically accurate scenes, trained via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with multi-dimensional rewards.

2609.33304.t: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
2609.33304.s: ExpActivator improves GUI personalization by activating only situation-relevant experience rather than appending full task history, boosting step success and reducing token use.

2610.03039.t: HyperThink: Text-to-Parameter Hypernetworks for Efficient Reasoning
2610.03039.s: HyperThink uses a hypernetwork to predict parameter updates for reasoning tasks, removing long inference traces while preserving accuracy with fewer tokens.

2610.05637.t: Visual Grounding Safety in Vision-Language Models
2610.05637.s: Vision-language models frequently comply with harmful requests when asked for spatial grounding rather than text answers, and targeted fine-tuning improves refusal rates without harming capabilities.

2610.02740.t: Prospective Hindsight: Self-Calibrating Reinforcement Learning via Prediction-Reality Gaps
2610.02740.s: Prospective Hindsight improves reinforcement learning by using the gap between predicted and evaluated outcomes to weight gradients, enhancing both performance and calibration across tasks.

2610.12611.t: SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
2610.12611.s: SoftwareGym automates synthesis of diverse, executable GUI applications to provide scalable training data that improves computer-use agent performance on out-of-domain benchmarks.

2610.12572.t: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
2610.12572.s: DiffusionART improves reinforcement learning fine-tuning of diffusion models by removing hidden consistency forces and enabling stable, efficient training without EMA tuning or differentiable rewards.

2610.07987.t: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs
2610.07987.s: VisionWeave introduces elastic visual representation weaving to adaptively allocate visual tokens by granularity, reducing token usage by 43% while preserving nearly all model performance across diverse tasks and serving conditions.

2610.13527.t: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
2610.13527.s: Multimodal language models use an intrinsic linear subspace called S-Space to encode object coordinates, supporting spatial perception, reasoning, and response generation, while also revealing bottlenecks in viewpoint transformation.

2610.13113.t: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
2610.13113.s: SynthSelf enables small models to learn new capabilities continuously by using a slightly larger model to generate in-distribution training data, reducing forgetting and improving acquisition.

2610.12570.t: Contextual Correction of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding
2610.12570.s: DCOCO restores intra-block token dependencies in diffusion-based speculative decoding by scoring multiple draft candidates in parallel, improving throughput across diverse decoding settings and concurrent loads.

2610.13021.t: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
2610.13021.s: EmbodiedCLBench evaluates continual learning in embodied agents by testing compositional skill reuse across basic and complex tasks, revealing stable but non-scaling experience benefits.

2610.07121.t: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
2610.07121.s: SoloQ enables calibration-free 4-bit quantization for diffusion language models by using normalized rotations and commit-time KV-cache compression, improving accuracy and inference speed.

2610.12978.t: Learning Representations to Guide Pixel Diffusion Transformers
2610.12978.s: Representation Guidance improves pixel diffusion transformers by forming compact internal representations that guide generation, achieving state-of-the-art image synthesis with fewer parameters.

2610.13944.t: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
2610.13944.s: InstantFusion introduces a shared latent interface that connects denoising trajectories across heterogeneous diffusion and flow generators via model-specific autoencoders and synchronized dynamics, enabling seamless cross-model transitions.

2609.36760.t: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
2609.36760.s: QuantMLA introduces a dual-path quantization framework for multi-head latent attention that enables low-bit caching of content and RoPE paths with minimal accuracy loss and improved serving throughput.

2610.10893.t: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
2610.10893.s: SAVER improves sparse-frame video reasoning by using dense views as training references with reinforcement rewards, achieving dense-level accuracy with far fewer frames.

2609.37950.t: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
2609.37950.s: Video-RSI enables video understanding agents to recursively improve by revising their observation harness through evidence-based testing of failure explanations, yielding better accuracy with lower visual cost.

2609.39566.t: From Given to Gathered Evidence: Agentic Learning for Longitudinal Medical Reasoning
2609.39566.s: CASE introduces clinical agents that autonomously seek evidence across longitudinal multimodal records, improving reasoning via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

2610.13316.t: ThinkDrag: Semantic Drag-Based Image Editing with Visual Reasoning
2610.13316.s: ThinkDrag is a multimodal framework that interprets drag instructions through visual reasoning to perform semantically meaningful image edits with improved plausibility and interpretability.

2610.00423.t: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation
2610.00423.s: Weight decay regulates the growth and peak of massive activations in transformers by balancing AdamW-preconditioned growth, with peak magnitude scaling inversely with the decay coefficient.

2610.12602.s: Models can support broader self-preservation by generating replay data and selecting preservation targets to mitigate forgetting beyond predefined tasks.

2610.00898.t: When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?
2610.00898.s: Post-training strategies for biological reasoning models do not reliably integrate foundation model representations, with models often relying on text rather than biological inputs despite accuracy gains.

2610.13205.t: Rethinking Relative Policy Differences Transfer of On-Policy Distillation
2610.13205.s: The study frames relative policy differences as implicit rewards for KL-regularized optimization, showing that task-specific training differences transfer effectively while scale differences do not, and that expert-reference pairing and target alignment determine success.

2610.11959.t: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
2610.11959.s: The MiMo-V2.6 series advances omni-modal foundation models through scaled reinforcement learning with larger batches, diverse agent environments, and robust reward grading, supported by stable training infrastructure.

2610.12126.t: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
2610.12126.s: SuperNav equips a pretrained multimodal large language model with a specialized agent harness and navigation tools to perform general-purpose robot navigation without fine-tuning, using a visual-point interface to link decisions to motion.

2610.12374.t: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
2610.12374.s: AgentGarten couples simulators with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive virtual worlds, enabling agents to learn efficiently through inherited experience and adversarially distilled visual observations.

2610.12461.t: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
2610.12461.s: OuroWorld converts static 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes into looping dynamic 3D cinemagraphs with diverse motion via a vision-language guided video synthesis pipeline and an inconsistency-robust periodic 4D deformation model.

2610.11287.t: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
2610.11287.o: Fusion Lab: Generative Vision Lab of Fudan University and SII
2610.11287.s: REMORY enhances long-horizon agent memory by adding learnable soft tokens to textual summaries, improving decision accuracy with minimal context usage.

2610.08215.t: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
2610.08215.s: Learn2Play Bench evaluates LLM agents on novel text-based games to measure learning from interaction rather than pretrained reasoning, revealing benefits of full experience retention, a human performance gap, and harness design effects.

2610.06801.t: MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers
2610.06801.s: Meta-Cached Sparse Attention improves diffusion transformer efficiency by selecting individual key-value tokens and reusing cached metadata across denoising steps, achieving faster generation with minimal quality loss.

2610.12289.t: TestPrism: Rethinking Test Evaluation Beyond a Single Reference
2610.12289.s: TestPrism reveals that evaluating LLM-generated tests against a single reference overestimates quality, and TestHelix improves test reliability through heterogeneous synthesis, peer validation, and recursive self-improvement.

2610.02967.t: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
2610.02967.s: Post-training text-to-image models with composed preference and rubric-based rewards improves human preference ratings and robustness to reward hacking.

2610.12327.t: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
2610.12327.s: SparseDecoding improves LLM decoding by aligning pruning calibration with autoregressive generation and optimizing sparse matrix-vector kernels for faster inference.

2610.12369.t: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
2610.12369.s: Code-Only-as-Policy replaces runtime vision-language models with explicit state-tracking code for robot control, enabling faster execution, failure recovery, and recursive self-improvement.

2610.12419.t: OneSearch-VL: Unified Multimodal Deep Research Agent for Image and Video
2610.12419.s: OneSearch-VL is a unified visual research agent using a Visually Grounded Evidence Graph to coordinate grounding, retrieval, and reasoning across images and video, with specialized training data, a traceability reward, and new benchmarks demonstrating large gains over prior models.

2610.12442.t: LEGO: A Lifting-Free Approach for Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
2610.12442.s: A learned view synthesizer provides structural alignment for a video diffusion model to generate egocentric video from exocentric recordings without explicit depth or point clouds, improving novel view synthesis.

2610.06406.t: What Did the Agent Actually Do? Evidence-Grounded Oversight for Long-Horizon Agents
2610.06406.s: Researchers propose a training-free evidence graph method to help users identify consequential autonomous agent decisions and locate supporting evidence for verification.

2610.12343.s: RISEBench++ benchmarks reasoning-driven visual editing across hierarchical reasoning dimensions and introduces a training-free agentic framework to improve instruction following, consistency, and plausibility.

2610.07730.t: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
2610.07730.s: SanSi converts looped language models into typed decision models that iteratively refine hidden states without token generation, improving accuracy and extending solvable reasoning depth across diverse tasks.

2609.39068.s: SparseEngine is a sparse-first inference engine that improves long-context LLM agent throughput by unifying diverse sparse attention methods with shared state management and pruning controls.

2610.12458.t: OmniCapBench: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning
2610.12458.s: OmniCapBench evaluates multimodal language models on audio-visual reasoning by scoring atomic, verifiable units across entities, shots, and audio events to expose temporal and cross-modal failures.

2610.12459.t: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
2610.12459.o: Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
2610.12459.s: WorldGuide couples planning and execution in a closed-loop visual framework to generate procedural videos that adapt to prior outputs, using hierarchical memory and a new step-level benchmark.

2610.12403.t: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
2610.12403.s: ViSkill is a visual-native framework that encodes successful agent interactions as reusable visual skill cards to jointly improve policy optimization and skill accumulation through a closed feedback loop.

2610.11366.t: SpatialOPSD: Self-Distilling Spatial Intelligence from Verified Coding Agent Traces
2610.11366.s: SpatialOPSD internalizes spatial reasoning into multimodal language models via self-distillation of verified agent traces, eliminating external tool dependencies while improving accuracy and generalization.

2606.03335.t: A GPU-Parallel Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
2606.03335.s: Hebero is a GPU-parallel benchmark for heterogeneous robot manipulation that enables multi-task reinforcement learning, and its DGPO framework with IW-ABC improves success by adaptively using demonstrations and weighting lagging tasks.

2609.35855.t: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
2609.35855.s: Mara Chain improves optimization of AI artifacts by refining rejected candidates into stepping stones, reducing rollouts and boosting performance across multiple benchmarks.

2610.11570.t: Scaling to Tens of Thousands of Test-Time Iterations with Loop-Native Attention Residuals
2610.11570.s: InfiLoop introduces a loop-native residual mechanism that selectively retains past computations and suppresses unreliable updates, enabling recursive Transformers to scale reasoning depth without degradation.

2610.12448.t: One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts
2610.12448.s: Recurrent single-block vision transformers with depth-conditioned expert mixtures match full-depth encoder accuracy at reduced storage and enable elastic-depth deployment.

2609.38527.t: Behavioral Persistence and Incomplete Functional Transfer of Co-evolved Communication in Evolutionary Robotics
2609.38527.s: Direct transfer of a co-evolved robot communication protocol from simulation to physical 3D environments yielded only partial success, indicating that preserving ecological and navigational conditions is essential for emergent signaling.

2610.08077.t: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
2610.08077.s: Prospective learning via Self-Retrospection Distillation uses hindsight experience to train foresight predictions, improving reinforcement learning when outcome rewards are uniform.

2610.10528.t: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
2610.10528.s: Long-WAM scales causal world-action models for real-time robot control by using autoregressive video pretraining to leverage long visual histories, improving success on long-horizon manipulation tasks while maintaining low-latency deployment.

2609.38169.t: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
2609.38169.s: STEPQuant is a spatial-temporal quantization framework that reduces memory usage of linear attention recurrent states by allocating precision based on error magnitude and memory lifetime.

2610.10524.t: GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation
2610.10524.s: GRACE compresses pretrained video autoencoders via a frozen base latent and learned residual, aligning outputs with a frozen diffusion transformer to enable efficient video generation with minimal adaptation.

2610.02054.s: UniWAM unifies physical reasoning, world generation, and action prediction through joint training on cleaned human and robot data with complementary supervision and flow-matching optimization, achieving strong embodied performance and scaling benefits.

2610.02368.t: Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation
2610.02368.s: ViGAR is a hierarchical framework that decomposes long-horizon robot manipulation into visual subgoal planning and subgoal-conditioned execution, improving success rates through shared world-model representations and in-context learning.

2610.10429.t: SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation
2610.10429.s: Self Gradient Forcing Plus improves autoregressive video generation by separating context-writing and denoising parameters, enhancing visual quality and long-horizon consistency without extra training data.

2610.08995.t: PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It
2610.08995.s: PhysEvo enables a frozen model to recursively improve robot manipulation by diagnosing failures, revising skills, and testing corrections without weight updates.

2610.03185.t: Gains and Collapse in On-Policy Distillation:A Reinforcement Learning Perspective
2610.03185.s: On-policy distillation improves language model performance by amplifying student behaviors favored by the teacher's implicit feedback, but can collapse into repetitive outputs when implicit rewards misalign with quality, which masking unhealthy responses and supervised initialization can mitigate.

2610.10437.s: Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching improves flow policy fine-tuning by replacing costly per-step vector-Jacobian products with a closed-form scalar adjoint and a value penalty, yielding large gains on hard robot learning tasks.

2609.39306.t: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation
2609.39306.s: ReSAIL improves iterative self-distillation for LLM agents by selecting informative interaction steps and preserving privileged-information behavior, preventing performance collapse across deployment cycles.

2610.07874.s: Negative-Policy OPD improves on-policy distillation by using a weaker negative policy's rollouts to provide explicit negative signals while preserving positive teacher supervision.

2610.09684.t: From Pareto to Preference: Personalized Test-Time Scaling via Amortized Agentic Policy Discovery
2610.09684.s: PersonTTS improves personalized test-time scaling by reusing prior search experience to discover controllers that jointly satisfy user-specific accuracy, latency, and cost requirements.

2610.07659.s: DLoop improves speculative decoding by looping multiple drafting stages before verification, reducing target-model passes and boosting speedup across diverse methods.

2610.10845.t: Real Long-Term Memory for AI: A 50-Million-Token Window That Is Faster and Cheaper Than Recompute
2610.10845.s: A memory layer saves and reloads exact key-value states for long prompts, reducing GPU energy and latency while preserving accuracy over 50 million tokens.

2610.10460.t: Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts
2610.10460.s: Δ-MOPD improves multi-teacher distillation by transferring logit shifts rather than endpoint policies, reducing inherited base interference and boosting performance when teacher signals are combined.

2610.05336.t: SheetSage2: Coherent Lead-Sheet Transcription with Synthetic Supervision
2610.05336.s: SheetSage2 unifies synthetic training data, structured decoding, and autoregressive distillation to improve automatic music transcription coherence and accuracy.

2610.08902.t: Agent Plasticity: Measuring Self-Improvement Through Experience
2610.08902.s: Self-improving AI agents vary widely in how efficiently they convert experience into future gains, with differences in plasticity, generalization, and artifact reuse determining success.

2610.07226.s: Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning identifies all minimal sufficient conditions for outcomes by assigning credit based on union coverage loss, enabling recovery of diverse minimal witnesses from a single verifier.

2610.10515.t: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
2610.10515.s: RoboJEPA establishes scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models, showing predictable improvements in imagination error and planning with compute, and enables zero-shot long-horizon robotic planning.

2609.36995.t: Salt++: Context-Aligned Post-Training for Few-Step Streaming Multimodal Generation
2609.36995.s: Salt++ improves few-step streaming audio-video generation via causal self-flow and context-aligned autoregressive distillation, boosting quality and enabling high-resolution synthesis.

2610.09457.t: DSReg: Provably Recovering Individual World Latents without Reconstruction
2610.09457.s: Under a structural diversity condition, dependency-sparsity regularization enables fully identifiable recovery of individual latent variables in joint-embedding predictive architectures without reconstruction, decoders, or labels.

2609.38562.t: LongTake: Learning to Sustain Dynamics in Long-Horizon Video Generation
2609.38562.s: LongTake improves long-horizon video generation by training autoregressive diffusion models with extended teacher forcing on real long videos, enabling sustained dynamics and high visual quality over 30- to 60-second rollouts.

2609.38680.t: ReGain: Restoring Subject Fidelity in Personalization on Synthetic Images
2609.38680.s: Fine-tuning text-to-image diffusion models on synthetic images degrades subject fidelity due to inflated classifier-free guidance, which is corrected by a training-free frequency-band scaling method called ReGain.

2610.09683.t: System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?
2610.09683.s: A fast learned actor defers uncertain decisions to a reasoning vision-language model in real-time Doom, improving selective deferral but failing to reach exits due to planning and perceptual errors.

2610.03543.t: DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation
2610.03543.s: DuoMatching improves streaming video generation by combining joint and marginal distribution matching with frame-level image supervision via LatentBridge and temporal sampling.

2610.07767.t: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
2610.07767.s: TRACE is an FP4 quantization framework for reinforcement learning training of Mixture-of-Experts language models that aligns training and rollout quantization to reduce discrepancy, enabling efficient low-precision rollout with comparable performance to higher-precision baselines.

2610.07043.t: TRIAGE: Direction-Aware Mismatch Stabilization of Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
2610.07043.s: TRIAGE stabilizes low-precision reinforcement learning by direction-aware rebalancing of policy-gradient updates, enabling native 4-bit execution with full-precision performance.

2610.08448.t: Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability
2610.08448.s: On-policy distillation with strict token alignment outperforms broader cross-tokenizer supervision by avoiding weak or conflicting gradient signals.

2609.37334.t: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing
2609.37334.o: Pohang University of Science and Technology
2609.37334.s: Self-compensating VLA adapts vision-language-action policies at deployment to pre-correct robot execution errors using online residual feedback, improving success across simulated and physical conditions.

2610.03607.t: World Action Learning via Interaction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance
2610.03607.o: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
2610.03607.s: WING transfers interaction knowledge from egocentric videos to robot policies by isolating hand-object dynamics and aligning low-frequency spectral components across embodiments.

2610.08463.t: UNREAL: Unifying Retrieval and Long-Context with a Single Model
2610.08463.s: UNREAL is a lightweight, model-native framework that unifies evidence selection for both large-scale retrieval and long-context inference using frozen LLM representations.

2610.08430.t: NeMo-DCR: Bit-Exact Delta-Compressed Refit for Scalable Agentic RL at Trillion-Parameter Scale
2610.08430.s: NeMo-DCR enables rapid, bit-exact cross-cluster model updates by transmitting only changed weights via affine mappings and XOR masks, reducing trillion-parameter refit times from hours to minutes.

2610.01892.t: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
2610.01892.s: Selection-based Structured Reasoning replaces open-ended reasoning with selectable candidates to cut latency while preserving performance in small multimodal agents.

2610.01218.t: AGO AI Quality Gate: Evidence-First Release Decisions for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2610.01218.s: AGO is an evidence-first quality-gate framework for industrial RAG systems that integrates a four-state decision model, layered scoring, probabilistic regression-risk quantification, and judge meta-evaluation to reduce unsafe promotions.

2609.32921.t: Adaptive Latent Capacity for World Models
2609.32921.s: ALeWM is a JEPA-based world model that learns ordered latent prefixes for efficient prediction and planning via adaptive prefix lengths and MixSIGReg regularization.

2610.00948.t: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
2610.00948.s: GUI-HARVEST automatically improves GUI agent harnesses by aligning actions with visual effects, comparing repeated executions, and converting recurring failures into reusable code edits without retraining the backbone model.

2609.34117.t: SlimWise: Decoupling Expert Pruning Across Prefill and Decode for Efficient MoE Serving
2609.34117.s: SlimWise improves Mixture-of-Experts serving by using full models for prefill and pruned models for decode with direct KV cache reuse, plus low-cost distillation to preserve accuracy.

2610.04933.t: DiVeR: Decision-Critical Verifier Learning for VLA Test-Time Scaling
2610.04933.s: DiVeR improves verifier-guided robot action selection by reweighting learning toward decision-critical states identified via action dispersion, boosting success without extra annotations or interaction.

2610.02781.t: OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation
2610.02781.s: A two-stage framework uses rubrics for token-level supervised distillation followed by reinforcement learning to improve open-ended language model evaluation without reward hacking.

2610.05842.t: HLA: Expressive Hybrid Linear Attention via Chunk-Wise Dynamic Mixing
2610.05842.s: Hybrid Linear Attention improves long-context modeling by using query-dependent routing over chunk-level affine states in Gated DeltaNet, boosting performance across extended contexts.

2610.08630.t: Towards In-Parameter Memory Augmentation for Large Language Models
2610.08630.s: This survey organizes methods for augmenting large language models with reusable parametric memory at inference time along axes of parameter placement and acquisition time.

2609.40127.t: Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression
2609.40127.s: Learnable Subspace Projections learn orthogonal low-rank subspaces end-to-end via global optimization, improving compressed transformer accuracy and reducing memory and latency.
