2609.35378.s: Hybrid attention architectures alter cross-lingual representation patterns in multilingual LLMs, with full-attention layers driving alignment spikes and alternative layer orderings accelerating multilingual training.

2609.29123.t: Accent Analogy Guidance: More Speaker Similarity at Equal Accent in Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning
2609.29123.s: Accent analogy guidance improves cross-lingual zero-shot text-to-speech by removing leaked reference accents without training, boosting speaker similarity above identity-accent trade-off curves across multiple models.

2610.05954.t: MEND: RL For Flow Models via Proximal Velocity Matching
2610.05954.s: MEND is a reinforcement learning method for flow models that uses capped reward gradients and quadratic displacement costs to selectively update samples, achieving faster convergence and higher scores than existing approaches without requiring KL penalties or frozen references.

2610.06847.t: S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation
2610.06847.s: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion combines autoregressive and parallel diffusion phases to improve rule adherence and temporal stability in video generation while reducing sampling time.

2610.05608.t: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
2610.05608.s: Kandinsky 6.0 Video is a family of diffusion models that generate synchronized audio-video clips with lip-sync via a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture and multi-stage training.

2610.04198.t: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
2610.04198.s: ALoDLM improves diffusion language models by adaptively allocating computation per token based on difficulty, closing the quality gap with autoregressive models while preserving fast parallel generation.

2610.03120.t: In-Distribution Forcing for Long Video Generation at Test Time
2610.03120.s: In-Distribution Forcing extends short-horizon autoregressive video diffusion to minute-scale generation by preventing out-of-distribution key-value entries through self-caching.

2609.37267.t: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym
2609.37267.s: Proactive LLM agents should be designed and evaluated through joint optimization of task capability, temporal compute allocation, and sustained user trust across multi-interaction scenarios.

2609.39490.t: OmniReasoning: Pushing the Limits of Audio-Visual Joint Reasoning
2609.39490.s: Researchers introduce a benchmark, automated data engine, and self-distillation method to improve audio-visual joint reasoning in omni-modal models.

2610.06648.t: Representation-Space MMD for Diffusion Language Models
2610.06648.s: Post-training diffusion language models via feature-space MMD minimization improves generation quality and decoding efficiency without full trajectory sampling.

2610.06833.t: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
2610.06833.s: Looped language models use learned depth priors and orthogonal input injection to stabilize recurrent states near fixed points, enabling faster training, decoding, and reinforcement learning with reduced memory.

2610.05076.t: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
2610.05076.o: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
2610.05076.s: Test-time training on self-generated text degrades predictions on independent human text, but evaluating updates on real evidence before committing them preserves adaptation benefits.

2609.24890.t: OSWorld-Pro: Process-based Evaluation for Computer Use Agents
2609.24890.s: OSWorld-Pro introduces procedural subgoal evaluation for computer-use agents using human-aligned LLM-Judges to expose process-level failure modes and reveal performance gaps versus end-state metrics.

2610.04109.t: SEER: Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting
2610.04109.s: SEER improves time series forecasting by using a self-evolving loop that refines event retrieval and builds causal knowledge from prediction errors while preventing data leakage.

2610.05303.t: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
2610.05303.s: Online Agentic Test-Time Training with self-distillation of verified trajectories into persistent LoRA weights improves long-horizon agent success and efficiency across tasks without external teachers or memory retrieval.

2609.36099.s: Inverse Distillation Unlearning unifies one-step generator distillation and targeted data removal for multi-step matching models without requiring retained training examples.

2610.05416.t: Prism: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Native 2K Joint Video-Audio Generation Model Training
2610.05416.s: Prism accelerates native joint video-audio generation at 2K by using dynamic sparse attention guided by local visual variance and audio-visual cross-attention to preserve semantic coherence and cross-modal interactions.

2610.05719.t: When to Switch: Reliable Action-Chunk Extension for Vision-Language-Action Models
2610.05719.o: Pohang University of Science and Technology
2610.05719.s: RACE predicts subskill transition timing to enable longer action chunks in vision-language-action models, reducing robot idle time and improving manipulation reliability.

2610.04616.t: PerturBot: Breaking Shortcut Priors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Perturbative Training
2610.04616.s: Perturbot improves vision-language-action policies by reducing reliance on spurious modality shortcuts through targeted data perturbations and relabeling, while GroundingFscore evaluates whether policies depend on task evidence rather than shortcuts.

2610.05894.t: Noise Out, Bias In: Targeted Bias Injection in Diffusion Language Models via Closed-Loop Activation Steering
2610.05894.o: Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
2610.05894.s: Masked diffusion language models expose answer distributions across denoising steps, enabling adversaries to inject targeted demographic biases via adaptive steering controllers that exploit internal activation feedback.

2609.34227.t: When Does Selection Replace Extraction? A Pre-Registered Test of Agent Memory with a Typed Decision Model
2609.34227.s: Raw conversation turns selected by a lightweight decision model match LLM-extracted memory accuracy at low cost, while reranking benefits diminish with larger budgets, reconciling conflicting prior results.

2610.02191.t: The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
2610.02191.s: The study introduces mathematical primitives and a benchmark to diagnose structural reasoning in LLMs, revealing discovery as a key bottleneck, and proposes a self-distillation framework to improve mathematical reasoning.

2609.35751.t: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
2609.35751.s: Foil improves looped mixture-of-experts models by flattening expert layers and untying attention, yielding lower pretraining loss and better routing with fixed parameters and compute.

2610.04137.t: Dynamic Harness Search: Building Multi-Agent Systems Per-Query via Prediction
2610.04137.s: SHIFT learns to build task-specific agent harnesses via a local LLM policy and value function, achieving higher accuracy and lower execution cost than baseline methods across diverse benchmarks.

2610.05739.t: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
2610.05739.s: HLA-WM combines geometry-guided retrieval with recurrent linear attention to improve long-range scene consistency in video world models without extra training.

2610.06666.t: What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
2610.06666.s: Flow-based Latent Reasoning trains continuous latent thoughts via flow matching to improve reasoning quality, diversity, and efficiency while reducing latency compared to explicit chain-of-thought.

2609.32423.t: PluginRSI: Recursive Improvement of Agent Harnesses with Reusable Plugins
2609.32423.s: PluginRSI improves language model harnesses by evolving reusable, composable plugins that accelerate optimization and transfer across tasks and models.

2610.04226.t: PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
2610.04226.s: Adaptive gradient scaling based on effective rank improves continual learning with LoRA by balancing stability and plasticity across long task sequences.

2610.05033.t: Code2Games: Enabling Coding Agents for Gaming World Generation
2610.05033.s: Code2Games is an agentic framework that generates consistent gaming worlds from natural-language intents by coordinating scene analysis, gameplay planning, and engine adaptation with persistent element correspondence, evaluated via the GameCode4D benchmark.

2610.02508.t: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
2610.02508.s: ProWAM improves robotic control by predicting sparse visual sub-goals to guide long-horizon action generation, achieving state-of-the-art results in simulation and real-world settings.

2610.03391.t: Native Action-Prior Learning from Videos for World Action Models
2610.03391.s: NAVA-WAM directly pretrains robot action policies from observation-only videos via native action-prior learning, improving scalability and control performance without requiring extensive action-labeled trajectories.

2609.38078.t: MotorMind: Scaffolding General Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot Robot Manipulation
2609.38078.s: MotorMind enables general-purpose vision-language models to perform zero-shot robotic manipulation by reasoning directly from observations and issuing mid-level actions with asynchronous feedback, achieving high success without specialized training or external tools.

2610.02826.t: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
2610.02826.s: Recursive Self-Rewrite reconstructs diverse harness-assisted solutions into reusable training trajectories, significantly improving terminal task performance under a general harness.

2610.03665.t: Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
2610.03665.s: Pivot-SD improves masked diffusion language models by selectively training high-impact token commitments via information-gain-based self-distillation, outperforming full-sequence and reinforcement learning baselines with minimal data.

2609.38879.t: Does Learning Protein Folding Generalize to Broader Reasoning?
2609.38879.s: Post-training language models on protein folding data improves broad reasoning across spatial, graph, scientific, and general benchmarks.

2610.00531.t: Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers
2610.00531.s: AI-generated scientific papers exhibit reasoning failures detectable via structural, argument, and artifact measures, and a harness-level revision framework reduces residual slop by enforcing evidentiary grounding.

2610.03367.t: Multilingual GSM-Symbolic: What determines capability transfer across languages?
2610.03367.s: Researchers introduce a multilingual math benchmark to identify model size, language resources, reasoning, and typology as key drivers of cross-lingual transfer, enabling performance prediction with minimal evaluation.

2610.03632.s: Researchers benchmark how video embeddings encode physical properties across simulations, finding a trade-off between cross-modal alignment and quantitative recoverability, and show that retrieved physical references improve generated video fidelity.

2609.39071.t: LexReward: A Taxonomy-Driven Reward Framework for Legal Language Models
2609.39071.s: LexReward introduces a taxonomy-based framework that evaluates legal responses across style, legal elements, and reasoning chains to build interpretable rewards for preference optimization and reinforcement learning.

2610.01153.t: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts
2610.01153.o: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
2610.01153.s: LOOM stabilizes and diversifies recurrent Transformer loops for MoE LLMs, enabling stable scaling to many iterations and improving perplexity and zero-shot accuracy under matched or expanded compute budgets.

2609.36529.t: Triadic Linear Attention: Three-Dimensional Recurrent States for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
2609.36529.s: Triadic linear attention expands recurrent memory states via third-order tensor updates to improve long-context modeling and recall with minimal added parameters.

2609.28339.t: Beyond Future Prediction: Denoising as Generative Adaptation for Robot Control
2609.28339.s: NowWAM couples generative diffusion objectives directly to robot action prediction via co-training on current observations, achieving faster and more robust control without requiring future visual targets.

2609.32182.t: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
2609.32182.s: KeyRec is a training-free framework that builds bounded visual memory for vision-language models by caching recent observations and organizing historical events, enabling efficient long-video reasoning with minimal token budgets.

2610.02179.t: From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
2610.02179.s: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation reveals that loss averaging, Adam's first moment, BF16 rounding, and gradient approximation methods significantly alter how teacher signals update student parameters and affect task performance.

2610.00722.t: JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts
2610.00722.s: JEPA-TTT adapts a pretrained latent dynamics predictor during testing via self-supervised updates to improve planning under changed environment dynamics without requiring goal images or online rewards.

2609.37925.t: Rollout-Marginal Distillation for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
2609.37925.s: Rollout-Marginal Distillation improves autoregressive video generation by scoring chunks independently against a teacher to avoid error accumulation, then restoring coherence with video-level distillation.

2610.02126.s: Local Support Learning uses a distribution-gated adapter and Gaussian mixture gating to prevent catastrophic forgetting in large language models during sequential training without prior data.

2610.02772.t: Improving Atomic-Fact Recall via Focused Views in Unstructured Knowledge Editing
2610.02772.s: FOVEATED reduces context reliance in unstructured knowledge editing by perturbing positional embeddings during optimization to balance learning difficulty across facts.

2609.32759.s: The Extender modifies the Transformer by adding a concatenation channel for attention keys and values, reducing persistent attention memory while maintaining or improving accuracy on short and long-context tasks.

2610.01509.s: Reinforcement learning post-training of language models improves single-shot accuracy but reduces solution coverage in agentic tasks, prompting a proposed sharpening tax metric and a temperature-adaptive sampling method to mitigate this trade-off.

2610.02162.t: World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling
2610.02162.s: World Observer decouples observation from action by using panoramic observers to track out-of-view regions, preserving object dynamics for accurate re-entry and enabling flexible scene coverage.

2610.01415.t: Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon Agents with Explicit Belief States
2610.01415.s: PoS improves long-horizon agent performance by maintaining explicit belief states that track world conditions and unresolved tasks, with validation and recovery mechanisms to prevent stagnation.

2609.32993.t: X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization
2609.32993.s: Hierarchical reusable action structures recovered from agent trajectories improve multi-step reinforcement learning and self-distillation across web and science benchmarks.

2610.00906.t: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
2610.00906.s: ActiveSaddler treats harness optimization as adaptive curriculum learning by modeling training scenarios as a non-stationary bandit that dynamically targets evolving failure patterns, improving agent performance over fixed curricula.

2609.35690.s: Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning integrates structural priors into skill interfaces to improve compositional and skill generalization in robotic tasks.

2609.37533.t: E-MoE: Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts for Non-Factorized Diffusion Language Models
2609.37533.s: E-MoE improves few-step masked diffusion by modeling cross-position correlations through discrete expert-routing latents without increasing active parameters.

2610.01215.t: AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent
2610.01215.s: AutoGUIWorld synthesizes GUI interaction trajectories by combining image generation with task planning, improving agent performance on real desktop and scientific tasks without deploying software environments.

2609.35259.t: On-Policy or Off-Policy Learning? A Systematic Study of Distillation Dynamics
2609.35259.s: In controlled distillation experiments, rollout policy has limited impact compared to token-level KL direction and learning rate, with on-policy benefits depending on objective and hyperparameters.

2609.32019.t: Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding
2609.32019.s: DMM improves decentralized multi-agent path finding by iteratively refining action intents through communication rounds, achieving high success rates and scalability without centralized control.

2609.36585.t: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
2609.36585.s: Small low-rank adaptations at early layers extend reference-tracking depth in frozen transformers by initiating a relay of chain identity through middle layers, greatly improving multi-step reasoning accuracy.

2610.01016.t: Scaling and Distilling Text Embeddings for Better Diffusibility
2610.01016.s: Stronger text embeddings improve diffusion language models, but distilling them into softer student encoders creates a more connected latent space that boosts generation quality.

2610.02185.t: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
2610.02185.s: LoopCD improves looped Transformer decoding by contrasting final and intermediate recurrent predictions without extra training, boosting accuracy and allowing fewer loops with lower compute.

2610.00559.t: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
2610.00559.o: university of science and technology  of china
2610.00559.s: PhysVista is a benchmark that evaluates vision-language models' physical intelligence through a closed loop of perception, reasoning, and plausibility assessment across real and generated videos.

2610.00812.t: Video Generation Models: A Survey of Post-Training and Alignment
2610.00812.s: This survey reviews post-training alignment strategies for video generation, categorizing methods by implicit and explicit signal enforcement and identifying open challenges in temporal consistency and safety.

2609.40097.t: AutoDataBench: A Data-centric Testbed for Accelerating Auto Research
2609.40097.s: AutoDataBench isolates data intelligence by evaluating how frontier LLMs diagnose, organize, and construct training data to improve model performance under fixed non-data conditions.

2609.39687.t: Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation
2609.39687.s: Neighborhood OPSD improves mathematical reasoning by pooling locally perturbed expert teachers, selecting corrections via peak and quantile routing, and training with clipped forward-KL divergence.

2609.38987.t: Smaller Models, Better Rejects: Preference Distillation Scaling
2609.38987.s: Smaller frozen models provide more effective preference rejects than self-generated ones for training larger students, with utility driven by task structure and low reference-policy coupling.

2610.02117.t: Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes
2610.02117.s: On-policy self-distillation with spatially grounded textual guidance improves multimodal reasoning and transfers synthetic training gains to real-world visual benchmarks.

2610.02181.t: OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning
2610.02181.s: OmniSeek enables an Omni-LLM to actively retrieve sparse audio-visual evidence across long contexts through iterative multi-turn reasoning, supported by synthetic multi-hop training data and reinforcement learning with cross-modal reward objectives.

2609.36388.t: Persona Dosing: Calibrated Activation Steering for Graded Trait Control
2609.36388.s: PersonaDose calibrates flow-time interventions to control language model persona expression by intensity without paired target training, improving trait expression and request accuracy across multiple models.

2609.34210.t: RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers
2609.34210.s: RLE-Bench evaluates coding agents across robot-learning workflows including control, policy learning, perception, and mechanical design using task-specific metrics aggregated into an overall RLE Index.

2610.00348.t: Removing the NEEDLE in the Haystack: Backdoor Removal in LLMs via Weight Orthogonalisation
2610.00348.s: NEEDLE removes backdoors from large language models by orthogonalizing weights against estimated backdoor directions while preserving refusal representations, achieving near-zero attack success with minimal performance shift.

2610.02206.t: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
2610.02206.s: KaliBench evaluates and improves large language models in translating natural language into precise executable commands for Kali Linux cybersecurity tools.

2610.00483.t: PixelDense: Dense Prediction as Representation Alignment for Pixel Diffusion
2610.00483.s: PixelDense accelerates diffusion transformer training by routing semantic and geometric teachers into orthogonal projection streams, improving generation quality and reconstruction while reducing training time.

2609.22753.t: Replacing Large Language Models with Jev Decision Models for Low-Latency Edge Service Orchestration
2609.22753.s: Integrating Jev's decision API into edge orchestration reduces admission latency and cost for bounded service contracts while maintaining high accuracy under load.

2609.36435.t: MemFold: Learning Compact Soft Memory for Long-Context Personalization via On-Policy Optimization
2609.36435.s: MemFold trains a fixed-size continuous memory interface for long-horizon assistants by optimizing memory content through task rewards and confidence-gated distillation from a frozen textual teacher, improving accuracy on extended personal memory benchmarks.

2609.34381.t: Joint and Cross-Modal Video-Audio Generation and Editing: A Unified Formulation and Design Taxonomy
2609.34381.s: This survey organizes joint audio-visual generative methods by coherence across time and semantics, proposing a unified formulation and taxonomy for cross-modal generation and editing.

2609.36484.t: The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation
2609.36484.s: RIDE improves on-policy distillation by extrapolating reinforcement-learning-induced representation shifts directly in hidden states, yielding stable gains over RL-trained teachers.

2609.38721.t: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
2609.38721.s: UniEvo-VL enables multimodal models to self-improve during inference by using internal critiques to guide diffusion-based generation without external teachers.

2609.39982.t: Mid-Harness: Scaling Actions Between Model and Harness for Terminal Agents
2609.39982.s: Mid-Harness improves terminal agent reliability by sampling and verifying actions at the model-harness boundary, showing that stronger verification and action scaling boost success more efficiently than trajectory scaling alone.

2609.40340.t: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery
2609.40340.s: EvoDuet improves evolutionary search with large language models by co-evolving solutions and retrieval queries to overcome knowledge gaps, boosting discovery gains across multiple optimization tasks.

2609.39045.t: RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement
2609.39045.s: RSIGame is an autonomous framework that uses recursive local and global self-improvement loops to iteratively refine generated games, internalize development experience into generators, and achieve higher quality with reduced token usage.

2609.40325.t: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents
2609.40325.s: WorldAuditBench evaluates multimodal agents on 3D anomaly detection, revealing that current vision-language models and agents struggle to integrate navigation and reasoning, performing far below human levels.

2609.38177.t: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
2609.38177.s: Imagine3D-LLM improves 3D reasoning by learning a compact scene representation via summary tokens decoded into 3D Gaussian Splatting, supervised by photometric reconstruction and next-token prediction.

2609.38597.t: PixelUMM: Encoder-Free Unified Image and Video Understanding and Generation
2609.38597.s: PixelUMM is an encoder-free unified model that processes images and videos directly in pixel space using shared linear projections and a mixture-of-transformers architecture to support both understanding and generation.

2609.39222.t: DC-SAE: Deep Compression Semantic Autoencoder for Faster Diffusion Convergence
2609.39222.s: DC-SAE is a decoupled compact semantic autoencoder that enables high-compression image generation with faster diffusion convergence by combining semantic and pixel-level encoders.

2609.32720.t: BiasReducer: Adaptive Bias Mitigation for Reward Models
2609.32720.s: BiasReducer edits linear reward heads to selectively reduce reward model dependence on superficial response attributes, improving robustness and downstream LLM behavior without retraining.

2609.34563.t: Rethinking Latent Visual Reasoning: Grounding Latent Reasoning in Visual Evidence
2609.34563.s: ReaLVR improves latent visual reasoning by supervising latent tokens with visual evidence and answer contrast, scaling robustly to 235B parameters.

2609.38660.t: Breaking Babel: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Long-Form Subtitle Translation
2609.38660.s: SMART is a self-evolving multi-agent framework that uses dynamic routing, persistent series memory, and judge-refiner loops to translate long-form subtitles with consistent terminology and style.

2609.33355.t: Unmask the State: When Does State Adaptation Matter for Masked Diffusion Language Models
2609.33355.s: Masked diffusion language models benefit from selectively adapting inference strategies during generation based on state-specific opportunity detectors rather than fixed rules.

2609.40316.t: Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts
2609.40316.s: Loop Scaling Laws jointly model recurrence and sparsity to predict loss and guide efficient design of looped Mixture-of-Experts models.

2609.39578.t: Thinking Outside the Box: Can Language Models Rely on External Guidance Selectively?
2609.39578.o: Southern University of Science and Technology
2609.39578.s: Researchers introduce Box²-Bench to measure how language models selectively rely on external guidance, finding that training with unreliable workflows improves robustness and selective use of helpful information.

2609.34599.t: The Low-Rank Structure of VLA Reinforcement Learning
2609.34599.s: Reinforcement learning reshapes vision-language-action policies through low-rank updates concentrated in action-expert timestep modules, where shift vectors encode task-specific denoising signals that predict success and enable steering.

2609.40285.t: PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents
2609.40285.s: PivotOPD improves language agent training by preventing early pivotal errors and teaching recovery via targeted on-policy distillation.

2609.32600.t: CUA-SWE: When Computer-Use Agents Meet Visual Software Engineering
2609.32600.s: CUA-SWE introduces a benchmark and evaluation framework for software engineering agents that use visual interface feedback and interaction to diagnose, repair, and verify code changes.

2609.40048.t: CoEvoWhen: Policy-Tool Coevolution for Ultra-Long Video Temporal Grounding
2609.40048.s: A policy-tool coevolution framework improves ultra-long video temporal grounding by jointly evolving agent policies and executable media tools from reasoning trajectories, reducing visual costs while boosting accuracy.

2609.38121.t: WUSH-KV: KV Cache Quantization with Data-Adaptive Transforms
2609.38121.o: IST Austria Distributed Algorithms and Systems Lab
2609.38121.s: WUSH-KV applies data-aware transforms to reduce quantization error in low-bit KV caches, improving long-context inference efficiency and perplexity.

2609.39661.t: The Evolution of Attention in Large Language Models: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Emerging Trends
2609.39661.s: This survey examines efficient sequence architectures through a five-dimensional framework of model-internal contextual memory, analyzing explicit-memory, recurrent-state, and heterogeneous mechanisms across major model lineages.

2609.29142.t: Not Every Token Is Worth Distilling: Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD
2609.29142.s: Direct-OPD transfers RL policy improvements via token-level log-ratio supervision, but suffers from vanishing probability mass; selective supervision using teacher-reference JSD improves student accuracy without extra computation.

2609.36333.t: ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning
2609.36333.s: ATLAS preserves relational geometry and calibrates latent distributions to improve planning stability and goal-reaching in world models.

2609.39358.t: Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost
2609.39358.s: Galahad introduces a memory layer that caches key-value states and selectively loads document sections to eliminate redundant computation during LLM inference, improving accuracy and reducing energy use.

2609.36012.t: In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications
2609.36012.s: In-context learning for robots connects contextual evidence to physical execution through four interface families, enabling task inference and transfer across changing conditions.

2609.34981.t: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
2609.34981.s: Simple-WAM predicts future video representations with a single forward pass to preserve generalization while avoiding costly denoising during inference.

2609.36380.t: LEGO-Anything: Coding Agents for 3D Scene Reconstruction
2609.36380.s: LEGO-Anything converts single images into editable Blender scene programs via iterative coding agents, with benchmarks and plugins improving reconstruction quality for vision tasks.

2609.37372.t: Think Before You Score: Thinking Reward Model for Visual Generation
2609.37372.s: Think Before You Score introduces case-adaptive rubrics and fine-grained rewards via Thinking Reward Models, paired with a dual-group relative policy optimization to improve visual generation evaluation and training.

2609.35427.s: An asynchronous LLM framework enables general agents to handle concurrent inputs and overlapping inference tasks across streaming video, gaming, and monitoring without specialized training.

2609.36071.s: LongCat-DeepResearch integrates an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow that separates planning, parallel investigation, and targeted revision to generate evidence-grounded reports.

2609.37868.t: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
2609.37868.s: GRAFT improves reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by replacing failed rollout groups with successful peer trajectories from complementary models, boosting reasoning performance without extra rollouts.

2609.31847.t: Omni-IO Skills: Harnessing Your Agent Omni-Native
2609.31847.s: Omni-IO Skills is a plug-and-play harness that enables general agents to coordinate multimodal workflows across diverse artifacts via hierarchical skills, dependency-aware orchestration, and a persistent asset registry.

2609.37725.s: Context Language Models treat context as an updatable file to enable intrinsic context management, improving efficiency and enabling parametric and in-context learning of management strategies.

2609.37559.t: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants
2609.37559.s: APM-Bench evaluates persistent memory for streaming video assistants across multi-session life trajectories, revealing trade-offs between recall reliability, latency, and storage.

2609.37236.t: Asking for What Was Never Requested: Horizontal and Vertical Proactivity in Agents
2609.37236.s: Researchers propose a method to train agents to pursue unstated information more effectively by selecting questions that retrieve needed evidence, improving task completion with fewer interactions.

2609.38008.t: HybridCUA: Learning to Orchestrate GUI and CLI for Computer-Use Agents
2609.38008.s: HybridCUA combines GUI and CLI interactions through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with CLI-aware rewards, improving computer-use agent accuracy across platforms.

2609.35954.t: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
2609.35954.s: ROSS improves large language model post-training by selectively supervising compatible historical self-generated rollouts, boosting performance across reasoning, coding, and agentic tasks without new rollouts.

2609.37441.t: Anisotropic Representations Improve Planning in JEPA World Models
2609.37441.s: AnisoWM introduces learnable anisotropic regularization to align latent planning costs with task outcomes in world models without altering inference.

2609.36601.t: SAKI: Maximal-Coupling-Routed Teacher Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
2609.36601.s: SAKI improves on-policy distillation by routing token-level supervision based on coupled rollout corrections, reducing mismatch while accelerating verification.

2609.38154.t: LongLive-Plug: Once-for-All Distillation for Video Generation
2609.38154.s: LongLive-Plug distills reusable video generation capabilities as LoRA adapters on a base model for training-free deployment across diverse downstream video diffusion models.

2609.38360.t: On the Off-Policy Teacher in On-Policy Distillation
2609.38360.s: SCOUT improves on-policy distillation by adapting the teacher to student-generated prefixes via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

2607.11433.t: Omni-Decision: Evidence-Ledger Planning for Omni-Modal Agents
2607.11433.s: Omni-Decision improves omni-modal agent planning by maintaining a compact evidence ledger and training the planner via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning on step-level trajectories.

2609.33326.t: ANTMAN: Adaptive Need Tracking for Multi-Agent Navigation in Large Information Spaces
2609.33326.s: ANTMAN is an adaptive multi-agent coordination framework that uses a dynamic Need Graph to guide worker selection and recovery based on evolving information needs, scaling efficiently across large search spaces.

2609.16409.o: Multimodal AI Lab - Technical University of Darmstadt
2609.16409.s: ReImaGin integrates image generation models into multimodal LLMs to enable flexible, open-ended visual reasoning that outperforms fixed vision tools and text-only methods.

2609.38087.t: CrossBFM: Distilling a Shared Latent Behavior Space Across Humanoid Embodiments
2609.38087.s: CrossBFM distills a shared behavior latent space across humanoid embodiments via a unified encoder and latent-conditioned tracking, enabling rapid cross-robot transfer of motion imitation, pose reaching, and reward optimization.

2609.37775.t: HiRAE: Hierarchical Representation Autoencoding with Residual Budgets
2609.37775.s: HiRAE improves reconstruction fidelity by hierarchically fusing encoder representations with bounded residual corrections, enhancing both image reconstruction and text-to-image generation quality.

2609.34605.t: PMOPD: Task Ordering, Cycling, and Parameter-Update Subspace Protection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
2609.34605.s: PMOPD uses geometry-aware projection of gradients and optimizer updates into task-specific subspaces to reduce cross-task interference during multi-teacher on-policy distillation, improving balanced capability integration.

2609.35530.t: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
2609.35530.s: AutoRef automatically optimizes multi-reference image generation harnesses via iterative code rewriting, significantly improving open-weight model performance across diverse settings.

2609.37040.t: Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders
2609.37040.s: Chat structure outperforms model computation for selecting explanation positions in auditing language models, allowing auditors to focus on a small fraction of tokens while recovering concealed threats via pretrained verbalizers.

2609.38059.t: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
2609.38059.o: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
2609.38059.s: WorldLine is an action-driven visual simulator that learns transferable robot dynamics from action-free videos and grounds them across diverse embodiments to improve policy evaluation and embodied planning.

2609.36965.t: Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks
2609.36965.s: Chinese-Jev is a lightweight encoder-only decision model for Chinese-language tasks that improves accuracy over existing Jev models through a unified training pipeline, domain-specific fine-tuning, and efficient on-device deployment.

2609.36636.t: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?
2609.36636.o: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
2609.36636.s: Looped language models improve reasoning beyond training limits through recurrence but harm knowledge retention, with effectiveness depending on layer placement and history-state conditioning.

2609.36130.t: Memory Is a Derivation: The Distributed-Evidence Paradox in Long-Term Agents
2609.36130.s: DerivAudit audits whether persistent memories in long-running LLM agents are actually supported by prior interaction history, revealing widespread unsupported admissions despite expanded evidence.

2609.33748.t: AnyStep-WAM: Budget-Aligned Distillation and Adaptive Inference for World Action Models
2609.33748.s: AnyStep World Action Model enables adaptive computation allocation for action generation by training budget-conditioned flow maps and selecting minimal denoising steps via a risk-aware scheduler, reducing steps by up to 85% without sacrificing success rates.

2609.36159.t: Principled Thoughts for Latent Recursive LLM Systems
2609.36159.o: University of British Columbia - Okanagan Campus
2609.36159.s: REST improves reasoning in continuous hidden states by adding representation-level losses to cross-entropy, boosting accuracy and interpretability across tasks.

2609.35932.t: Same Bytes, Different Authority: Reserved-Token Representations in Chat-Template Prompt Injection
2609.35932.s: Reserved control tokens in chat templates significantly amplify prompt injection attacks against LLM agents compared to equivalent subword sequences, with instruction tuning reinforcing this vulnerability and standard tokenizer mitigations failing to protect tool-protocol channels.

2609.35232.t: Beyond Selection: Token Parameterization for Extreme Visual Token Compression
2609.35232.s: Braco is a lightweight visual-token compression method that separates basis transformation from coordinate organization to improve efficiency and preserve accuracy under extreme compression budgets.

2609.37089.t: Real2Gym: Building Gyms from Videos, Bringing Skills to Robots
2609.37089.s: Real2Gym converts real-world demonstrations into interactive simulation environments to learn reusable robot manipulation skills that transfer to physical robots without model updates.

2608.19669.t: Scaffolding Minds: Optimizing Latent Visual Target Representations for Multimodal Reasoning
2608.19669.s: Scaffolding Minds improves multimodal reasoning by introducing a dedicated scaffolding encoder for optimized latent targets and a stochastic reinforcement learning sampler that enables exploration, yielding substantial gains over existing latent reasoning methods.

2609.36352.t: StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks
2609.36352.s: StructRL improves long-horizon vision-language-action policies by providing structured intermediate rewards based on verifiable subtask completions during online reinforcement learning.

2609.36314.t: Fractional State Space Transition for Long Sequence Modeling
2609.36314.s: FRAC replaces exponential forgetting with power-law long memory via fractional dynamics, improving long-context performance in state space models while maintaining efficient training and decoding.

2609.33620.t: Learning Dynamics of Continual Learning: A Unified View of Data Attribution, Forgetting, and Plasticity Loss
2609.33620.s: Language model updates interact through shared readout geometry and residual connections, causing either beneficial learning or interference and plasticity loss over time, which can be predicted and controlled via token-level interaction analysis.

2609.36014.t: Persistence Forcing: Exploiting Feature Specialization in Pixel-Space Diffusion
2609.36014.s: Pixel-space diffusion transformers are enhanced by assigning different refinement budgets to feature groups, yielding persistent global features and active local features that guide generation via Persistence Forcing.

2609.34314.t: PlaylistEval: Can Video-Language Judges Be Trusted at Day Scale and Beyond?
2609.34314.s: PlaylistEval introduces an automated framework to build long-video benchmarks that test whether video-language judges can retrieve and compare evidence across 100-hour playlists, revealing that even frontier models achieve only moderate accuracy.

2609.37687.t: WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation
2609.37687.s: WISE-ATTA improves active test-time adaptation by strategically allocating limited supervision across test streams based on online drift signals, reducing annotation costs while maintaining robustness.

2609.33757.t: YuE2: Unifying Symbolic and Audio Music Generation at Frontier Quality
2609.33757.s: YuE2 unifies symbolic and audio music generation via symbolic planning, producing readable scores and full-song audio with state-of-the-art quality and agentic editing capabilities.

2609.35748.t: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers
2609.35748.s: TaH2 improves test-time scaling of looped transformers by selectively applying extra iterations to tokens that benefit, yielding steeper accuracy-compute gains.

2609.35347.t: Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
2609.35347.s: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation merges specialist language models but suffers from unbalanced feedback across domains, which domain-normalized rescaling fixes to recover lost skills.

2609.35457.t: How Far Are We from Removing the Visual Encoder? Scaling Laws for Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
2609.35457.s: Encoder-free multimodal language models scale comparably to encoder-based ones, with the visual encoder's benefit diminishing as compute increases and vision processing adapting within the language model.

2609.33848.t: QwenGyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Training xLong-Horizon Agents
2609.33848.s: QwenGyre is an end-to-end framework that enables efficient online reinforcement learning for extreme-long horizon LLM agent tasks by dynamically reallocating GPUs and deduplicating redundant branching trajectories.

2609.35767.t: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
2609.35767.s: UMM-Reflection uses reinforcement learning over full reflection loops to jointly improve image diagnosis and revision in unified multimodal models, boosting generation quality without external verifiers.

2609.32577.t: Groupwise Agentic Grading and Advantage Redistribution for Code Agent RL
2609.32577.s: GAGAR improves reinforcement learning for code agents by redistributing credit based on quality rankings from an agentic grader, yielding more stable training and higher-quality implementations.

2609.33325.t: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
2609.33325.s: VisionHOPE introduces a self-modifying visual backbone where memory and learning co-evolve through coupled memories and stability-controlled updates, achieving strong results across vision tasks.

2609.33665.t: CompoWorld: Compositional Environment Scaling for General Agents
2609.33665.s: CompoWorld scales agent training by composing reusable services across environments, using verified trajectories and a completion-focused reward to improve cross-service task performance.

2609.36246.t: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
2609.36246.s: OLIVE improves language model distillation by continuously regenerating student prefixes for online teacher supervision, outperforming offline methods while preserving model capabilities.

2609.33781.t: Surprising Success, Repeated Failure: Entropy-Guided Credit Assignment for Exploration in LLM Reasoning
2609.33781.s: EAPO improves reinforcement learning for reasoning by asymmetrically weighting token-level credit using policy entropy to reinforce surprising successes and correct repeated failures while preserving exploration.

2609.35673.t: FlowTool: Controlling Tool Parameter in Image Retouching via Flow Matching
2609.35673.s: FlowTool frames tool-based image editing as conditional flow matching to directly generate structured editing parameters, improving accuracy and efficiency over autoregressive multimodal agents.

2609.32534.t: DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth
2609.32534.o: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
2609.32534.s: DepthBench reveals that residual connection design determines whether deeper transformers achieve effective computation, with HC and Full AttnRes outperforming normalization-based variants across depth-to-width ratios.

2609.32540.t: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
2609.32540.s: FlashForward accelerates chunk-based autoregressive video diffusion by reusing in-flight key-value caches across stages and stabilizing generation with sparse clean anchor latents.

2609.34972.t: Just MLPs: Efficient Visual State Reconstruction for Multimodal Language Models
2609.34972.s: δ-Vision reduces multimodal model costs by replacing repeated Transformer updates of visual tokens with lightweight low-rank adapters that preserve all tokens for text retrieval.

2609.32712.t: MassAlloc Attention: Let Attention Allocate Its Own Compute
2609.32712.s: MALA is a fused attention primitive that allocates post-score computation based on normalized attention contributions, reducing latency and training costs while preserving full-attention accuracy.

2609.32472.t: AdaTutoRank: Learning to Rerank Document Sets via Adaptive Tutoring Optimization for RAG and Deep Research
2609.32472.s: AdaTutoRank improves document reranking by adaptively tutoring a setwise model with hierarchical rubric hints to distinguish key contributors from redundant ones.

2609.34470.t: Precise Editing and Flexible Referencing for Interactable Worlds
2609.34470.s: EditWorld is a video world model that enables precise, interactive world editing through streaming instructions and reference images, using gated causal attention and sparse context mechanisms to support long-horizon generation.

2609.33203.t: Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers
2609.33203.s: Adaptive cross-layer connections in diffusion transformers enable selective retrieval of earlier features, accelerating convergence and improving image synthesis quality with minimal overhead.

2609.33399.t: SciGen-Verifier: A Multimodal Reasoner for Explainable Verification in Scientific Image Generation
2609.33399.s: A reasoning-driven multimodal verifier with hierarchical explainable feedback improves scientific image generation assessment and iterative correction.

2609.32704.t: CoWindow Attention: Full Causal Coverage Is a Collective Property
2609.32704.s: CoWA distributes causal history access across attention heads via structured sparse windows, reducing latency and memory while preserving full coverage and model performance.

2609.23033.t: WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
2609.23033.s: Wavefront Decoding accelerates looped language models by concurrently batching draft and verification steps within shared recurrent blocks, achieving substantial latency reductions.

2609.35069.t: RenderRank: Learning to Rerank Text with Compressed Visual Tokens
2609.35069.s: RenderRank improves reranking efficiency by scoring documents via compressed visual representations rather than text tokens, reducing input length while maintaining high accuracy.

2609.34848.t: Can We Trust the Teacher? Decoupled Credit Direction-Magnitude for Self-Distillation
2609.34848.s: Decoupled Credit Self-Distillation separates step-level credit direction and magnitude to improve policy optimization and reduce reliance on teacher supervision.

2609.35706.t: Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science
2609.35706.s: AI Night-Scientist uses reinforcement learning to train language models to strategically depart from predictable reasoning, improving the diversity, originality, and impact of scientific ideas.

2609.33148.t: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
2609.33148.s: DroneWAM is an efficient world-action model for drone navigation that predicts future states in representation space, uses adaptive rollout to reduce computation, and achieves high trajectory accuracy on a new aerial dataset.

2609.31892.t: NVAlign: Direct-Gradient Optimization for Non-Verbal Control in Continuous Autoregressive Flow Matching Text-to-Speech
2609.31892.s: NVAlign improves non-verbal vocalization control in continuous autoregressive flow-matching text-to-speech via direct-gradient post-training with a frozen recognition reward model and gradient surrogates.

2609.34771.t: When Do Model Internals Help? Exploring the Role of Representation Engineering in LLM Safety
2609.34771.s: Behavioral safeguards and representation engineering offer complementary strengths for AI safety, with alignment methods providing stronger control and text monitors yielding better detection, while representation techniques remain competitive under low-data or cost-constrained conditions.

2609.35616.t: EvolvingAvatar: Interactive 3D Head Generation That Adapts as Conversations Unfold
2609.35616.s: EvolvingAvatar adapts 3D head generation during live interaction via self-supervised test-time updates guided by dyadic audiovisual context, improving conversational motion over time.

2609.33791.t: Do We Really Need KL Divergence for On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models?
2609.33791.s: On-policy distillation for LLMs can use simple directional rewards rather than KL divergence, and multi-teacher consensus improves cross-domain performance.

2609.33487.t: What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?
2609.33487.s: Spatio-temporal masking strategies for EEG foundation models were systematically compared across MAE and JEPA frameworks, revealing robust performance across configurations and a novel JEPA failure mode, with optimal masking achieving high downstream accuracy at reduced compute.

2609.34313.t: ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents
2609.34313.s: ControlScope evaluates how extensively language model agents should revise running workflows by comparing continuation, argument editing, and full replacement strategies across filesystem, ALFWorld, and AppWorld tasks.

2609.35247.t: AnswerMap: Faithful Spatial Interpretability of VLMs from Answer Posteriors
2609.35247.s: AnswerMap constructs a black-box visual rationale from a vision-language model's output head to localize answers, validate faithfulness, and correct errors without text tokens.

2609.26333.t: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
2609.26333.o: IST Austria Distributed Algorithms and Systems Lab
2609.26333.s: Disaggregated quantization uses separate formats and storage for prefill and decode phases to improve speed and accuracy at very low bit widths.

2609.31394.t: InternW0-Δ: A World Action Model Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Actions with 20K+ Hours of Open Data
2609.31394.s: InternW0-Δ is a unified world action model that integrates visual dynamics, semantic, geometric, and motion priors via a mixture-of-transformers architecture and causal imprint learning for robot manipulation.

2609.28845.t: LastOPD: Taming Collapse in Latent On-Policy Distillation
2609.28845.s: LastOPD applies latent supervision only at the final layer during a brief crossfade to prevent training collapse and improve reasoning performance in distilled language models.

2609.29167.t: IndicBankBench: Evaluating Safety and Reliability of Language Model Assistants in Indian Retail Banking
2609.29167.s: IndicBankBench evaluates Indian banking assistants across 799 cases with multi-stage checks, revealing that strict reliability is substantially lower than at-least-once success.

2609.24749.t: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
2609.24749.s: D-JEPA aligns latent world models with decision outcomes by learning decision-relevant relations among candidate futures, improving action selection across robotics and autonomous driving.

2608.09444.t: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching
2608.09444.s: Continuous depth batching enables efficient inference for looped language models by dynamically scheduling loop steps and managing caches across variable-depth tokens.

2609.29474.t: CodeGraph: Open-Taxonomy Knowledge Graph for Source Code with Wikidata Grounding
2609.29474.s: A pipeline using a code-specialized large language model extracts semantic concepts from source code, links them to Wikidata, and constructs a large-scale open-taxonomy knowledge graph with calibrated quality assurance.

2609.30670.t: TRACE: Temporal Audit and Condition-aware Evaluation of Streaming Video Understanding
2609.30670.s: TRACE introduces a condition-aware benchmark and evaluation framework that reveals hidden differences in streaming video understanding by tracking evidence timing, history processing, and response behavior across models.

2609.28654.t: Training Object Permanence in World Models
2609.28654.s: Researchers created a cognitive-science-inspired dataset and benchmark to evaluate and improve object permanence reasoning in video generation world models.

2609.29429.t: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
2609.29429.s: Jev, a reinforcement-learning-trained calibrated decision model, is benchmarked on ten alignment failures via varied questioning and input fields, achieving high detection accuracy at far lower cost than LLM judges.

2609.29362.t: Parts-of-Speech as Emergent Categories in SAE Latent Space
2609.29362.o: CoLingLab | Computational Linguistics Laboratory - University of Pisa
2609.29362.s: Sparse autoencoders encode part-of-speech distinctions through distributed, stable groups of latents rather than individual features, with recoverability driven by structured feature groups rather than lexical memorization.

2609.29444.t: IterSynth: Rethinking Deep Search Agents via Role-Decoupled Iterative Synthesis
2609.29444.s: IterSynth separates planning and synthesis roles with a persistent summary state and role-decoupled reinforcement learning to improve long-horizon deep search performance.

2609.29647.t: AgentKernel: The Trust-Native Agentic Operating System
2609.29647.s: AgentKernel proposes a trust-native operating system that enforces mandatory security across agent identity, perception, cognition, and execution to prevent prompt injection, memory poisoning, and tool misuse.

2609.28923.t: ViRDM: Taming Representation Distribution Matching for Few-Step Causal Video Generation
2609.28923.s: ViRDM eliminates the teacher and critic from few-step video diffusion post-training by matching precomputed representation distributions, reducing resource use while improving video quality.

2609.24308.s: HappyWorld-Bench evaluates world model reliability across video, spatial, and embodied settings using human comparisons and automated behavioral metrics, revealing significant consistency and responsiveness gaps.

2609.23038.t: Spatial-Interactor: Learning Spatial Reasoning through Interaction with the Observable Physical World
2609.23038.s: Spatial-Interactor trains vision-language models via a three-level curriculum on interaction trajectories to improve local state transition modeling and long-horizon spatial integration.

2609.22947.t: RewardVerse: Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization for Video Reward Modeling
2609.22947.s: RewardVerse introduces rubric-guided evaluation and two-stage optimization to stabilize video reward scoring and improve reinforcement learning for video generation.

2609.26637.t: Capable yet Parsimonious: Extracting and Characterizing Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Frontier Models
2609.26637.s: Researchers induced frontier language models to reveal hidden reasoning traces via a custom API tool, finding that externalized reasoning matches native performance and reveals systematic differences in how models organize and compress intermediate steps.

2609.27656.t: InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions
2609.27656.s: InternW0 is a physical world model that combines asynchronous multi-frequency video prediction and robot control to enable scalable, contact-aware real-world manipulation and scientific workflows.

2609.26489.t: Calibration as a First-Class Criterion in LLM Evaluation
2609.26489.s: Calibration of language model confidence should be paired with standard performance metrics across NLP subfields to ensure trustworthy evaluation and safe deployment.

2609.25270.t: RULER: Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for SVG Generation
2609.25270.s: RULER uses instance-aware rubric scoring from a vision-language judge to provide fine-grained rewards for reinforcement learning of SVG generation without ground truth or human labels.

2609.24981.t: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
2609.24981.s: A geometry-native autoencoder provides a shared latent space that improves both visual quality and 3D coherence for conditional generation by jointly encoding appearance, depth, cameras, and point maps.

2609.26550.t: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
2609.26550.s: A decision-only judge offers a low-cost first evaluation pass that closely matches stronger judges on common tasks, with a frozen cascade preserving nearly all accuracy by escalating only uncertain cases.

2609.25804.t: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
2609.25804.s: Taste-Bench evaluates agent decision-making at trajectory forks to measure long-horizon judgment, revealing limited frontier model accuracy and demonstrating trainable improvements via distillation.

2609.15987.s: BPO reformulates policy mirror descent via Bellman equations to optimize autoregressive reasoning without state-value estimation, improving LLM reasoning with verifiable rewards.

2609.24657.t: Circuit Hypernetworks for Quantum-Augmented Diffusion Language Models
2609.24657.s: HyperQ integrates token-conditioned quantum residual branches into frozen masked-diffusion language models, enabling efficient training of wide quantum circuits that improve downstream performance with less data.

2609.25186.t: From Pattern Recognizers to Personalized Companions: A Survey of Large Language Models in Mental Health
2609.25186.s: This survey organizes LLM applications in mental health into three evolutionary phases—information tools, empathetic conversationalists, and longitudinal personalized companions—to map progress and guide future development.

2609.25053.t: LatentPort: Beyond KV Cache - Cross-Model Transfer of Recurrent Memory in Hybrid Language Models: A 4B-to-9B Hybrid-State Handoff Without Target Prefix Replay
2609.25053.s: Researchers demonstrate direct transfer of persistent recurrent inference states between differently sized hybrid language models, achieving near-native continuation quality without replaying historical context.

2609.25636.t: RoboFollow: Unveiling the Instruction Following Mirage in Embodied Agents
2609.25636.s: RoboFollow reveals that embodied agents rely on visual redundancy rather than language, using high-entropy scenes and hierarchical diagnostics to expose instruction-following failures that standard benchmarks miss.

2609.24972.t: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
2609.24972.s: Regularized recursive self-improvement of agent harnesses improves out-of-distribution performance by constraining edit proposals and selections to favor reusable mechanisms over benchmark-specific memorization.

2609.24984.t: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
2609.24984.s: WorldCrafter uses a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory to maintain long-horizon consistency and camera control in video world models during extended scene exploration.

2609.13814.t: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation
2609.13814.s: A proactive full-duplex system with separate audio-visual and audio models enables continuous perception, native speech generation, and asynchronous tool execution for real-time dialogue.

2609.22966.t: Transferring the Intelligence of VLMs to Robotic Control
2609.22966.s: RoboDawn enables vision-language models to control robots via discrete commands and in-context learning, achieving strong zero-shot and one-shot performance across simulated and real-world tasks without robot-specific training.

2609.23088.t: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
2609.23088.s: OmniEdu is a family of instruction-tuned educational foundation models that improve K-12 problem solving, curriculum understanding, and tutoring through capability-balanced training data.

2609.24997.s: VideoGen-Agent is a multimodal reinforcement-learning agent that coordinates external video generation, augmentation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions to improve fidelity, identity preservation, and temporal consistency.

2609.24220.t: Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC): Universal Retrieval-Aware Ingestion of Enterprise Documents via PDF Normalization and Multimodal Markdown Conversion
2609.24220.s: D-RAC converts diverse documents into retrieval-optimized Markdown via multimodal LLMs and deterministic chunk planning, reducing cost and time while preserving accuracy.

2609.23377.t: One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents
2609.23377.s: A category-aware reinforcement learning framework trains specialized experts and integrates them via multi-teacher distillation to improve software engineering task resolution across heterogeneous categories.

2609.23863.t: Grounded Action Model: 3D Grounding as a Foundation for Robotics
2609.23863.s: Grounded Action Models integrate 3D object grounding with multi-stream transformers to improve robot manipulation under visual shifts and long-horizon planning.

2609.24974.s: Harness-Zero distills specialized agent harness behaviors into model weights via agent-as-harness correction, enabling deployment without the optimized harness while improving task success.

2609.23658.t: Why Do Video Diffusion Models Violate Physics? Unveiling the Flaws in Attention Mechanisms
2609.23658.o: BUPT-Center of Intelligent Science and Technology
2609.23658.s: Researchers identify that rotary position embedding causes premature spatial locking in video diffusion models and propose a step-dependent frequency scaling fix to improve physical coherence.

2609.24432.t: 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation
2609.24432.s: Information-efficiency ratio improves sparse on-policy distillation by selecting tokens with reliable gradient estimates, boosting reasoning performance at very low supervision budgets.

2609.24118.t: CARE: Experience-Guided Atomic Corrective Execution for Vision-Language-Action Policies
2609.24118.s: CARE improves robotic manipulation recovery by learning from execution failures to synthesize corrective demonstrations and trigger atomic adjustments via 3D monitoring.

2609.23989.t: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
2609.23989.s: Researchers introduce ACLArena to study agent continual learning, analyzing forgetting and generalization to compare integration methods and propose a replay-based routed LoRA expert recipe that improves multi-domain agent capabilities.

2609.24682.t: Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies
2609.24682.s: Distilling physical scene knowledge from frozen world models into vision-language-action policies via feature alignment improves robotic control without increasing inference cost.

2609.24115.t: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
2609.24115.s: EdgeGen generates database-grounded edge-case tasks from agent specifications to improve tool-calling agents via automated finetuning and harness optimization without human annotation.

2609.22068.t: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
2609.22068.s: CodeMidas converts existing source code into executable reinforcement learning tasks for training coding agents, improving performance across repair, construction, and terminal benchmarks.

2609.22000.t: RecreationWorld: Scalable and Verifiable Environments for Hybrid Computer-Use Agents
2609.22000.s: RecreationWorld and RecreationBench evaluate hybrid computer-use agents that interleave graphical exploration with software development to recreate running applications across platforms, revealing limited success on interactive and computed tasks.

2609.21619.t: Calibrating Teacher--Student Discrepancy for On-Policy Distillation
2609.21619.s: Calibrated On-Policy Distillation removes teacher self-deviation from the training signal by estimating it via privileged interventions, improving reasoning model distillation.

2609.19169.t: SiliconBench: Speed, Memory, and Fidelity for LLM Serving on Unified-Memory Desktops
2609.19169.s: SiliconBench evaluates Apple Silicon LLM serving engines across speed, memory, and fidelity, finding that only three stacks meet all quality and scalability requirements.

2609.19969.t: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
2609.19969.s: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a multimodal MoE model using a CED architecture and aggressive KV cache compression to lower compute, storage, and bandwidth costs for long-context agent workloads.

2609.20519.t: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
2609.20519.s: SoL-Pi improves token efficiency in autonomous coding agents through recursive self-improvement mechanisms, reducing costs by about one third while maintaining performance.

2609.20804.t: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
2609.20804.s: Component-level analysis of a coding harness reveals that context management prevents overflow failures, planning saves costs for stronger models, and predefined tools help weaker bash users, guiding modular harness design.

2609.20511.t: When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation
2609.20511.s: On-policy distillation causes student responses to grow excessively long due to termination-token mismatch with teachers, which is reduced by treating equivalent end-of-sequence tokens as shared stopping actions.

2609.20800.t: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
2609.20800.s: JEPA-Anything applies orthogonal predictive factorization across diverse domains to improve predictive world modeling, intervention forecasting, and scientific discovery.

2609.19671.t: When2Think: Learning When and How Much to Reason
2609.19671.s: When2Think is a reinforcement learning framework that adaptively controls reasoning depth per problem to improve accuracy while reducing token usage without requiring learned critics or reward models.

2609.20744.t: Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation
2609.20744.s: Video DeltaNet accelerates video diffusion by combining local Softmax attention with bidirectional linear memory for long-range context, achieving substantial inference speedups while preserving generation quality.

2609.17653.t: Reflect, Revise, Reuse: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents
2609.17653.s: EvoSkill-GUI enables GUI agents to dynamically revise reusable skills during deployment via execution feedback, improving performance across mobile and desktop benchmarks without additional training.

2609.19499.t: Sample Count Is Not Enough: Candidate-Generation Strategy Shapes the Energy and Performance of LLM Test-Time Scaling
2609.19499.s: Test-time scaling with multiple reasoning candidates is more efficient with larger batched generation calls than sequential smaller batches, requiring reporting of schedule and GPU metrics alongside accuracy.

2609.17488.t: LimiX-2: A Contextual Mechanism Network Towards General Structured-Data Intelligence
2609.17488.s: LimiX-2 is a scaled tabular foundation model using contextual mechanism networks and context-conditional masked modeling to learn joint data structures, improving predictions and causal skeleton recovery.

2609.19134.t: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
2609.19134.s: ScienceIDE converts scientific code repositories into executable agent environments for training and evaluating scientific AI models, yielding improved code repair and reasoning capabilities.

2609.17708.t: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents
2609.17708.s: XConf improves language model confidence estimation by leveraging stored past graded episodes and reflection rather than only current inference outputs, achieving strong calibration and discrimination at lower cost.

2609.18805.t: ProgramDistill: From Interactive Web Apps to Verifiable Reference-Guided SWE Tasks
2609.18805.s: ProgramDistill introduces a scalable benchmark that evaluates coding agents by requiring them to infer and implement features discovered through interaction with fully functional reference applications.

2609.15810.t: VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention
2609.15810.s: VC-Attention accelerates low-bit diffusion transformer attention by smoothing value outliers via online clustering and replacing softmax exponentials with fused log-to-probability casting, improving speed and fidelity across video generation models.

2609.18487.t: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
2609.18487.s: ActionPiece improves action tokenization for vision-language-action models by preserving physical distance rankings through joint representation and quantization supervision, boosting policy performance.

2609.19138.t: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
2609.19138.s: GPT-Policy enables robots to learn from demonstrations and feedback via vision-language models without parameter updates, improving task completion through contextual action verification.

2609.17909.t: Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control
2609.17909.s: Zing-0.5 is a 5B autoregressive world model enabling real-time interactive exploration and event control via combined keyboard and text inputs with efficient streaming generation.

2609.14320.t: SpectralShift: Effective Context Window Extension of Gated DeltaNet via Spectral Reparameterization
2609.14320.s: SpectralShift improves long-context training of Gated DeltaNet by reshaping decay spectra and scaling learning rates for alpha projections.

2609.16679.t: AI for Games in the Foundation Model Era
2609.16679.s: AI applications across the game lifecycle are organized into six roles, highlighting transferable capabilities and setting-specific limitations that require targeted validation.

2609.16034.s: StepAudio 3 Music is a long-form music generation model that uses discrete-continuous tokenization, flow-matching diffusion transformers, and mixture-of-experts planning to generate high-quality songs and instrumentals with explicit structural control.

2609.14857.t: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
2609.14857.s: ModularRSI improves agent harnesses through benchmark-independent, contrastive, modular evolution that isolates recurring deficiencies and evolves functional components independently.

2609.06986.t: Continual Learning Mechanisms Compose for Long-Horizon Memorization
2609.06986.s: Composing complementary continual learning mechanisms substantially improves long-horizon memorization in language models by combining data, function, and weight anchors with merged low-rank updates.

2609.17523.t: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
2609.17523.s: ScienceBuddy is an interactive workspace that integrates self-improving scientific agents into research workflows through recursive harness evolution and model reinforcement learning.

2609.15195.t: HarnessVLN: Unifying Training-Free Embodied Navigation through an Agent Harness
2609.15195.s: HarnessVLN is a zero-shot framework that validates navigation plans against spatial evidence and maintains hierarchical memory to improve embodied navigation without training.

2609.16372.t: Register Tokens for Bounded-State Reasoning in Diffusion Language Models
2609.16372.s: Masked diffusion language models can maintain reasoning across generation chunks using continuous register tokens instead of retaining prior text, improving math and code performance.

2609.16816.t: ImpossibleRubrics: Stress-Testing Generated Rubrics as Reward Signals
2609.16816.s: ImpossibleRubrics benchmarks rubric robustness on impossible tasks, showing that specific tailored rubrics are more exploitable than generic ones and that a quality gap—not task difficulty—drives adversarial vulnerability.

2609.14803.t: Another Blueprint In The Wall: How to Ask Frontier AI Like a Kid?
2609.14803.s: Experiments with frontier models show that framing prompts for a school audience causes repeated convergence on a shared neural architecture motif, while removing that framing yields heterogeneous responses, raising questions about shared design priors versus independent convergence.

2609.17521.t: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
2609.17521.s: PhysStream is an autoregressive image-to-video model that uses online structured scene memory and sparse velocity-increment signals to enable interactive, physics-grounded control over multi-object dynamics during generation.

2609.14011.t: Convergent Emergence of In-Context Learning Across Modalities
2609.14011.o: Center for Language and Speech Processing @ JHU
2609.14011.s: Few-shot in-context learning emerges across multiple data modalities with shared task difficulty patterns, supporting a convergent emergence hypothesis.

2609.17320.t: Emergence World: Adversarial Stress-Testing of Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems
2609.17320.s: Persistent multi-agent environments reveal that individually safe AI agents can form interconnected systems with emergent, long-horizon failure modes that resist containment.

2609.16057.t: OmniHarness: Harnessing Generalizable Visual Generation via Symbolic Policy Learning
2609.16057.s: OmniHarness improves visual generation by learning reusable symbolic policies, enabling mid-task verification and self-directed practice to expand capabilities without updating model weights.

2609.15818.t: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
2609.15818.s: Atria Dawn Preview is a foundation agentic language model trained through verified tool interactions that achieves strong benchmark results and demonstrates a shift toward human-AI project-level collaboration in scientific research.

2609.11638.t: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
2609.11638.s: Vidu S2 introduces real-time interactive avatar and video editing models that support high-resolution spatial video generation and dynamic reference updates.

2609.14858.t: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
2609.14858.s: Dream-RSI enables scalable recursive self-improvement by using historical discovery replay to evaluate exploration policies offline, reducing costly online evaluations.

2609.13356.t: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
2609.13356.s: ZGCM-1 is a 7B open foundation model that combines internal reasoning with external tool use, trained via efficient architecture-system co-design, progressive long-context scaling, and autonomous agent workflows to achieve strong reasoning and efficiency.

2609.15364.t: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
2609.15364.s: RSIAgent is a training-free multi-agent framework that enables recursive self-improvement via autonomous memory construction and broad-then-deep exploration to adapt digital agents to new environments.

2609.13285.t: Grouped Value Attention: Efficient KV Caching via On-Demand Key Reconstruction
2609.13285.s: Grouped Value Attention reduces transformer KV cache size by storing grouped values and reconstructing keys via a learned linear map, achieving near-GQA accuracy with a smaller persistent cache.

2609.14973.t: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
2609.14973.s: PhysBrain 1.5 unifies physical environment understanding, action generation, and future state prediction via joint autoregressive training on discrete vision-language, motion, and visual target sequences, achieving state-of-the-art open-source embodied performance.

2609.15478.t: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
2609.15478.s: A benchmark requiring agents to programmatically reconstruct real-world videos in Blender reveals that current models achieve high perceptual similarity but struggle to retain spatiotemporal facts.
